title: AI/ML Technical Architect ( Salesforce exp is a must)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
The AI Technical Architect operates at the intersection of strategy and execution — acting as both a Strategist, shaping the long-term technical vision for AI adoption, and an Orchestrator, coordinating people, systems, and processes to turn that vision into working solutions. This role is central to designing, scaling, and governing AI and Agentforce-driven architectures across the delivery organization, ensuring technical decisions align with business outcomes and customer value.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Define and evolve the technical architecture strategy for AI initiatives, aligning with broader business and platform roadmaps.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies (LLMs, agentic frameworks, automation platforms) and recommend where they create differentiated value.
* Partner with delivery, product, and engineering leadership to translate business goals into scalable, secure, and maintainable AI architectures.
* Establish architectural standards, patterns, and best practices for AI solution design across teams.
* Assess technical risk, feasibility, and total cost of ownership for proposed AI initiatives.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams (engineering, data, product, delivery) to ensure AI solutions are designed, built, and deployed cohesively.
* Serve as the technical glue between strategy and execution — ensuring architecture decisions are implemented consistently across squads and projects.
* Facilitate technical governance forums, architecture reviews, and design decision checkpoints.
* Drive alignment between multiple parallel AI workstreams, resolving dependencies and technical conflicts.
* Mentor and enable technical teams and solution architects on AI-first design principles.
* Ship working AI solutions hands-on — prototype, build, and iterate quickly rather than only designing on paper.
* Take ideas from concept to production, personally building agents, automations, and integrations when needed to prove value fast.
* Champion a bias for action: favor working demos and MVPs over long design documents.
* Continuously experiment with new AI tools and techniques, bringing working proofs-of-concept back to the team.
* Balance speed of shipping with architectural soundness, ensuring builds are scalable beyond the prototype stage.
* Own end-to-end technical quality of AI solutions from design through production readiness.
* Define and monitor architecture health metrics (scalability, reliability, cost-efficiency, security posture).
* Ensure compliance with data governance, responsible AI, and security standards across all AI implementations.
* Provide technical escalation support for complex AI/architecture issues across the portfolio.

**You're Our Person If...**

* 10+ years of experience in software/solution architecture, with demonstrated depth in AI/ML or agentic systems architecture.
* Proven experience architecting and delivering enterprise-scale AI solutions (e.g., LLM-based systems, automation platforms, Agentforce, or equivalent).
* Strong grasp of cloud-native architecture, integration patterns, and platform scalability principles.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as both a strategic thinker and hands-on technical orchestrator across multiple teams.
* Experience with Salesforce platform architecture is highly valued.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Champion an AI-first development workflow by utilizing advanced AI developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate Salesforce Field Service solution development, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, mobile application development, and integrations while maintaining platform security, performance, and Salesforce best practices.
* Practical fluency in using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems to maximize development productivity, optimize Field Service solutions, document custom implementations, and deliver secure, scalable, and high

**Even Better If...**

* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or equivalent architecture certification.
* Experience leading AI governance, responsible AI, or AI risk frameworks.
* Track record of mentoring architects and senior engineers.
* Exposure to multi-org, multi-cloud, or complex enterprise topology environments.
* Hands-on experience building and deploying AI agents (e.g., Agentforce, custom agent frameworks) in real-world settings.
* Practical experience with AI tools such as Gemini, Cursor, and Claude for coding, prototyping, or workflow automation.
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, LLM orchestration, and agentic tool-use patterns.
* Comfortable working directly in code/config to build and ship — not purely a design-and-document architect.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Agentic AI Architect
description:
**Agentic AI Architect**

Candidate will be responsible for designing the foundational architecture and engineering blueprints for our next-generation AI agent ecosystems. Candidate will translate strategic AI objectives into robust, scalable, and secure technical designs, ensuring our agentic solutions effectively address complex business challenges in areas such as supply chain optimization, intelligent automation and enhanced customer/vendor experiences. Candidate will provide deep technical guidance, mentor other engineers and champion architectural best practices for building cutting-edge agentic AI systems.

**Role:**

* Lead the definition and design of the end-to-end reference architecture for enterprise-grade agentic AI systems, encompassing agent lifecycle management, interaction protocols, knowledge integration, and action execution frameworks.
* Develop detailed architectural blueprints, patterns, and standards for building, deploying, and integrating AI agents across diverse business domains and existing enterprise platforms (ERP, CRM, SCM, WMS).
* Design core components of the agentic ecosystem, including reasoning engines (leveraging LLMs), planning modules, perception interfaces, memory systems, and tool/API integration layers.
* Ensure architectural designs meet critical non-functional requirements, including scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and cost-effectiveness.
* Drive the technical evaluation and selection of appropriate frameworks (e.g., Gogole ADK, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI), platforms, and tools for our agentic AI stack.
* Serve as a senior technical expert and thought leader on agentic AI architecture, multi-agent systems, LLM-driven autonomy, and related technologies.
* Lead the development of advanced prototypes and proof-of-concepts for core architectural components and novel agentic capabilities to validate design choices and mitigate technical risks.
* Provide expert technical guidance and architectural oversight to development teams working on specific AI agent projects.
* Collaborate with the Agentic AI Lead and other stakeholders to align architectural decisions with the overall AI strategy and roadmap.
* Establish and promote engineering best practices, coding standards,and design patterns for agentic AI development within the CoE.
* Contribute to the development of Agentic AI Tech Ops/MLOps/LLMOps strategies specifically tailored for the lifecycle management of AI agents.
* Ensure that architectural designs and implementations adhere to ethical AI principles (fairness, transparency, accountability, privacy) and relevant compliance requirements.
* Create and maintain comprehensive architectural documentation.

**Required :**

* Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical field.
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering and AI/ML system development, with at least 5-7 years focused on architecting and designing complex, distributed AI systems.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in architecting and implementing Agentic AI systems or autonomous intelligent agents.

title: Staff Engineer, Software
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
  
  
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
  
  
DESCRIPTION:
  
  
Join Thermo Fisher Scientific, the world leader in serving science, as a Staff Engineer, Software to make a meaningful impact. In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural guidance while developing innovative software solutions that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Working in a supportive, multi-functional environment, you will design and implement sophisticated solutions across our product portfolio, from cloud platforms to scientific instrumentation. You will support the growth of other engineers, drive adoption of best practices, and help shape the technical direction of critical projects. This position offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies while contributing to groundbreaking scientific discoveries.
  
  
Lead AI/ML, chemometric, and LLM capabilities for bioprocessing and industrial software, turning process data into reliable models and secure decision-support tools.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead architecture and delivery of AI/ML, LLM, and data products for bioprocessing and industrial applications.
* Partner with software, process, automation, and scientific teams to define valuable use cases and measurable outcomes.
* Own data science workflows from acquisition and analysis through feature engineering, validation, deployment, and monitoring.
* Build ML models for multivariate and time-series data, including anomaly detection, forecasting, soft sensing, and optimization.
* Apply chemometric methods such as PCA and PLS to process and analytical data for PAT and process insight.
* Develop data pipelines, APIs, and integrations for equipment, instruments, historians, automation, and enterprise systems.
* Build LLM applications using RAG, semantic search, and approved knowledge sources; evaluate retrieval and answer quality.
* Productionize AI/ML and LLM solutions with reproducible experiments, versioning, testing, CI/CD, deployment, and monitoring.
* Ensure solutions address security, privacy, data integrity, validation, explainability, and responsible AI.
* Set engineering direction, review designs, mentor engineers, and communicate model behavior and limitations to stakeholders.

**Required Experience**

* 9–14 years of relevant experience in software engineering, AI/ML, data science, industrial analytics, or process automation.
* Strong Python and software engineering skills; experience with C#/.NET or Java is valuable.
* Applied data science and ML experience, including statistical analysis and supervised or unsupervised methods.
* Experience with multivariate and time-series data, model validation, performance metrics, and uncertainty.
* Experience with data pipelines and SQL or NoSQL databases; time-series or historian data is desirable.
* Working knowledge of MLOps, including reproducible experiments, model versioning, deployment, and monitoring.
* Hands-on chemometrics experience, including PCA, PLS, calibration, and model validation.
* Understanding of LLMs, embeddings, semantic retrieval, vector search, and RAG.
* Experience building LLM applications and evaluating grounding, retrieval relevance, and response quality.
* Knowledge of secure LLM design, data privacy, safeguards, and human review.
* Experience integrating software with industrial or laboratory systems.
* Understanding of process control, instrumentation, sensors, and process data acquisition.
* Experience productizing software or analytics and leading or mentoring multidisciplinary teams.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Spectral or process analytical data experience (such as NIR or Raman), PAT, or bioprocessing experience.
* Familiarity with OPC UA, PLC, SCADA, or MES integration.
* Knowledge of GxP, validation, data integrity, cybersecurity, and responsible AI.

title: Integration Architect
description:
At Prolifics, we are currently implementing multiple solutions in Software Development, and we are looking to hire a talented
**Integration Architect**
for our development center in India. This position would be based out of Hyderabad and is a permanent position.

If you are looking for a high growth company with rock-solid stability, if you thrive in the energetic atmosphere of high-profile projects, we want to talk to you today! Let’s connect and explore the possibilities of having you onboard the Prolifics team!

**Job Title: Integration Architect**

**Primary skills: Integration architecture and strategy**

**Secondary skills: Veeva Vault and Snowflake delivery**

**Location: Hyderabad (Mindspace#12B)**

**Educational Qualification: B.Tech/BE/M.Tech/MCA/M.Sc**

**Experience: 15+ yrs**

**Job Description:**

**Work Window:**

* **Offshore:7:00 PM–3:00 AM IST**
* **Onsite: EST time zone**

**Key responsibilities**

**Integration architecture and strategy**

•           Define the target integration architecture linking Veeva Vault (Clinical Operations, eTMF, CTMS, Study Startup, QualityDocs, RIM) with Snowflake and downstream systems.

•           Set integration standards: API-first patterns, event-driven and batch designs, error handling, monitoring and reusable components.

•           Maintain the integration roadmap in partnership with Clinical Operations, Data Management, Biostatistics, Regulatory and Quality.

•           Veeva Vault and Snowflake delivery

•           Lead build of pipelines from Veeva Vault to Snowflake using Vault REST APIs, Vault Loader, Direct Data API, Vault Java SDK and Spark messaging.

•           Model clinical operations data in Snowflake (raw, curated and consumption layers) using Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, dbt and secure data sharing.

•           Integrate CROs, EDC (e.g. Medidata Rave, Veeva CDMS), IRT/RTSM, safety and finance systems with Vault and Snowflake.

•           Keep pipelines in step with Veeva's three general releases per year through regression testing and release impact reviews.

**AI-driven integration automation for CTMS**

•           Design and deploy AI and LLM solutions that automate CTMS data flows: document classification and metadata extraction for eTMF, site and milestone data mapping, and CRO data reconciliation.

•           Build AI agents and workflows (e.g. Snowflake Cortex, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Veeva AI) that detect data anomalies, propose mappings and generate integration code and tests.

•           Put human-in-the-loop review, model validation and performance monitoring in place so AI outputs stay accurate and auditable.

•           Compliance and quality

•           Deliver integrations under GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11 and GAMP 5, including validation documentation (URS, FS, IQ/OQ/PQ, traceability).

•           Apply data integrity (ALCOA+), GDPR and HIPAA controls, including access management and audit trails.

•           Follow a risk-based approach to validating AI components in line with emerging FDA and EMA guidance.

•           Leadership and stakeholder management

•           Lead internal engineers and external partners (system integrators, Veeva Services, CROs); review designs and code.

•           Translate business needs from clinical and quality teams into technical requirements and delivery plans.

•           Report on integration health, costs, risks and benefits to IT and business leadership.

**Required qualifications**

•           Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Life Sciences or a related field, or equivalent experience.

•           10+ years in enterprise integration or data engineering, with 5+ years in pharma, biotech or CRO environments.

•           3+ years leading Veeva Vault integrations (Clinical Operations suite, ideally CTMS and eTMF), including Vault APIs, Vault Loader and Direct Data API.

•           3+ years building on Snowflake: data modelling, Snowpipe, Streams and Tasks, performance tuning, security and cost management.

•           Hands-on delivery of AI or machine learning automation in production integration workflows, preferably for CTMS or clinical operations data.

•           Strong skills in Python and SQL; working knowledge of Java or JavaScript for Vault SDK and middleware.

•           Experience with an integration platform such as MuleSoft, Boomi, Informatica or Azure Integration Services, and with orchestration tools such as Airflow or dbt.

•           Working knowledge of clinical trial processes, study lifecycle and data standards (CDISC, TMF Reference Model).

•           Delivered validated systems under GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 and GAMP 5.

•           Proven technical leadership of engineers and vendors, with clear communication to non-technical
**stakeholders.**

**Preferred qualifications**

•           Veeva Vault certifications (e.g. Vault Platform Administrator, Clinical Operations) and SnowPro Core or Advanced certification.

•           Experience with Snowflake Cortex AI, Document AI or Snowpark for in-platform machine learning.

•           Built AI agents or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions over clinical documents or TMF content.

•           Experience migrating from a legacy CTMS (e.g. Medidata, Oracle Siebel) to Veeva Vault CTMS.

•           Background in oncology or cell and gene therapy trials, or in a commercial-stage biotech.

•           Familiarity with FDA and EMA guidance on AI in drug development, and with the EU AI Act.

Experience working across UK and US teams and with global CRO partners

**About us:**

**Prolifics Corporation Limited**
is a Global Technology Solutions Provider with presence across North America (USA and Canada), Europe (UK and Germany), Middle East & Asia. In India, we have offshore development centres: 2 in Hyderabad & 1 in Pune.

For more than 40 years, Prolifics has transformed enterprises of all sizes including over 100 Fortune 1000 companies by solving their complex IT challenges. Our clients include Fortune 50 and Fortune 100 companies across a broad range of industries including Financial Services, Insurance, Government, Healthcare, Telecommunications, Manufacturing and Retail. We rank consistently in
**Dream Companies to Work for**
and
**Dream Employer of the Year**
ranking from World HRD Congress, ranked 7 in 2019.

We encourage you to visit us on
**www.prolifics.com**
or follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube and other social media to know more about us.

If you are interested to know more, please send an updated copy of your resume to
**suma.pullagurla@prolifics.com**

title: Software Engineering Advisor
description:
**Introduction to Evernorth**

Evernorth Health Services India, established in Hyderabad in 2024, is an innovation hub for Evernorth Health Services, the pharmacy, care, and benefits division of The Cigna Group. The India innovation center focuses on generative AI, product development, analytics, process improvement, and software engineering to support global healthcare solutions and business transformation initiatives.

**Position Overview**

Evernorth is a leading health services organization. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the development team on initiatives aligned with Evernorth’s strategic objectives and partner with subject matter experts to accurately translate business requirements and logic into engineering solutions.

The role requires deep subject matter expertise in Master Data Management (MDM), with a strong focus on the Client and Producer domains. The Offshore MDM SME is responsible for ensuring high-quality, reliable, and well-governed master data through operational oversight, data quality management, and cross-functional collaboration.

The Offshore MDM SME will serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and IT teams for Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) Master Data Management initiatives. This individual will provide both functional and technical leadership across MDM and related IDMC services, including Business 360,Customer 360,Refrence 360, Data Profiling, Cloud Data Integration (CDI), Cloud Data Quality (CDQ), and Cloud Application Integration (CAI) supporting complex integration landscapes.

Recognized as a trusted advisor to both business and technology leaders, this individual will contribute to strategic initiatives while ensuring seamless day-to-day operations, effective data governance, and successful delivery of MDM solutions.

**Responsibilities**

* Understand the current technical landscape and the desired future-state architecture. Assess the existing architecture and business processes for managing Master Data Management (MDM) solutions.
* Evaluate the functional and non-functional requirements of the target MDM solution and design the future-state architecture, including data ingestion, data quality rules, data models, match and merge processes, workflows, user interfaces, batch integrations, and real-time services.
* Lead the design, implementation, and evolution of the global Customer Master Data platform. This role requires deep hands-on expertise in the Informatica IDMC Customer 360 SaaS solution, combined with strong delivery leadership capabilities.
* Be accountable for designing and governing the Customer MDM architecture while orchestrating end-to-end Agile delivery across upstream and downstream systems and stakeholder groups. The technology stack is based on Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (Customer 360 SaaS) and Databricks.
* Lead end-to-end MDM development and production operations, including data profiling, data quality components, configuration of business entities, pages, workflows, and business events. Design and develop ingestion and egress jobs, as well as Cloud Application Integration (CAI) processes for job orchestration and scheduling.
* Build and implement Informatica MDM jobs to perform programmatic merges using data received from source files.
* Play a critical role in ensuring high-quality, governed, scalable, and business-aligned customer master data capabilities that support global growth and enhance customer experience.
* Manage and resolve production support incidents through ServiceNow (SNOW), ensuring adherence to defined SLAs, operational standards, and best practices.

**Qualifications**

**Required Skills:**

* Overall 5 + years of hands-on experience in Master Data Management with 3+ years of Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS solution and delivering successful MDM implementations.
* Proven experience with Informatica IDMC Customer 360 SaaS / Multidomain MDM Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS) Informatica Reference 360 (strong plus) Strong experience integrating MDM with Databricks platforms.
* Deep understanding of: Customer data models Match & Merge strategies Data governance frameworks Data quality methodologies Experience in defining and implementing MDM solution architectures Strong knowledge of batch and API-based integration patterns.
* Experience leading agile delivery in complex, multi-country environments Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills Certifications in Informatica MDM (Developer / Administrator) are a plus.
* Key Competencies Strategic thinker with hands-on technical depth Strong ownership and accountability mindset Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to balance governance rigor with business agility Strong communication skills across business and technical audiences.
* Strong implementation experience across Informatica MDM SaaS(Business/Customer/Refrence 360), Data Profling,CDI,CDQ and CAI is mandatory.
* Strong SQL, data modeling, integration architecture, performance tuning, and troubleshooting skills.

**Required Experience & Education:**

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline with 5 to 14 years of experience in application program development, or the equivalent in education and work experience.

**Desired Experience:**

* Experience supporting large-scale Informatica SaaS MDM platforms
* Certification in Informatica IDMC MDM technologies.
* Experience in cloud-based data management ecosystems.
* Experience with Informatica CLAIRE AI capabilities.
* Previous Healthcare or health services industry experience

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

*Evernorth is an Equal Opportunity Employer actively encouraging and supporting organization-wide involvement of staff in diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts to educate, inform and advance both internal practices and external work with diverse client populations.*

title: Data Solutions Architect 3rd
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
A career in our Business Intelligence practice, within Data and Analytics Technology services, will provide you with the opportunity to help organizations uncover enterprise insights and drive business results using smarter data analytics. Leveraging a collection of organizational technology capabilities, including business intelligence, data management, and data assurance, we help our clients drive innovation, growth, and change within their organization using business intelligence.
  
  
Our rapid business intelligence solutions, data visualization, and integrated reporting dashboards allow our team to deliver agile, highly interactive reporting and analytics that help our clients to run their business, understand what business questions can be answered and how to unlock the business drivers more effectively.
  
  
**Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:**
Crowe is looking for a Data Solutions Architect to be a leader on our team of problem solvers with extensive consulting and industry experience. The primary focus will be helping our clients solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  
  

* The shift timings for this role is 5:00PM - 2:00AM IST (7:30AM - 4:30PM ET)
* Serve as subject matter expert on Business Intelligence engineering platforms (Ex - Microsoft SQL Server, Azure Data platform, Snowflake, DBT) demonstrating platform capabilities and promoting application of toolset to address business needs and maximize the value realized from technology investment.
* Oversee the design and deployment of data pipelines, analytics platforms, and reporting frameworks that improve transparency and support decision-making.
* Utilize advanced analytics, machine learning, and statistical modeling techniques to detect anomalous activity and patterns in transaction data.
* Ensure data quality and integrity through best practices in data management and governance.
* Mentor and lead a team of data analysts and consultants, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
* Provide technical guidance and career development opportunities to junior team members, ensuring high levels of performance and professional growth.
* Facilitate cross-functional collaboration among teams to integrate data-driven insights into broader business strategies.
* Develop and implement frameworks that align with regulatory changes and help clients stay ahead of compliance requirements.
* Work with legal and compliance teams to translate regulatory requirements into actionable data analytics strategies.
* Contribute to proposals and presentations for potential clients, demonstrating expertise in data analytics and regulatory compliance.
* Represent the organization at industry events and conferences as a subject matter expert in data consulting.
* Drive internal innovation by identifying emerging technologies and methodologies that can improve service delivery.
* Participate in presales engagements to manage the vision and expectations of a client’s multiple stakeholders and create a conceptual solution design involving effort estimation, technical and functional solution, execution methodology, project plan, and team.
* Participate in the systems development process, including planning and monitoring systems development efforts, coordinating activities with other groups, reviewing deliverables and communicating status to the project manager and client.
* Lead and provide technical guidance and mentorship to other team members.
* Architect, implement, deploy, and support analytical databases and pipelines in an Azure environment
* Create proofs of concepts as necessary for architectural vision, strategy, and tool evaluation.
* Document, diagram, and present complex/technical material that can be understood by a non-technical audience.

title: Solutions Architect- IP
description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
  
  
TTEC Digital seeks a Solutions Architect to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!
  
  
**The work:**
We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982.
  
  
This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.
  
  
**Who we hire — the DNA:**

* Self-starters and do-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.
* Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
* Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
* AI-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
* Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
* Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
* You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.
* No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

**What You Will Do:**
**The role:**

* The technical face to enterprise customers — scoping deployments, designing tenant configurations, and getting customers live fast (same-day with Desktop Intercept).
* You're selling and deploying a platform that combines voice, desktop, intelligence, and AI — technology that changes monthly — so you learn constantly and demo fearlessly
* Startup environment: the deal, the deployment, and the product are all moving at once, and you thrive in that.

**What you'll own:**

* Pre-sales and deployment architecture
* Tenant configuration and plugin enablement design
* Customer integration scoping (CCaaS / CRM / SIP)
* live demos that win — show-me applies to customers too
* The customer's voice back into Product and Engineering
* Your committed go-live timelines.

**Who you are:**

* A self-starter with grit and a closer's instinct — you like winning, and a signed customer going live is your scoreboard
* Show-me mentality: you'd rather run the live demo than present the slide
* You adapt fast when the product shifts under you (it will, weekly), love new technology, and use AI tools daily — including in your own demo and scoping workflow
* A do-er who owns the messy middle instead of escalating it
* A team player who translates in both directions: business requirements into technical needs for engineering, platform capability into business value for the customer.

**What You Will Bring:**

* 8+ years of solutions architecture/sales engineering in contact-center, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS.
* Technical enough to design an integration on a whiteboard and credible enough to own a CTO conversation — you keep the respect of senior engineers on both sides of the table.
* Knows CCaaS / CTI, SIP / RTP, and CRM landscapes cold.
* Strong working knowledge of the modern AI stack — LLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, transcription/translation — deep enough to answer the customer's AI architecture and data-security questions without phoning home.
* Has taken enterprise customers live and owned the messy middle — network quirks, security reviews, procurement, the works.
* Hands-on enough to configure a tenant, read an API payload, and debug a customer integration in real time — a troubleshooter, not a talker: when the pilot breaks at 4pm, you isolate it.
* Understands event-driven platform architecture well enough to scope custom integrations accurately — what's config, what's a connector, what's a feature request.
* Deployment playbook craft — turns every go-live into a repeatable playbook so the second customer is faster than the first; this is how one SA scales.
* Enterprise security fluency — comfortable in InfoSec reviews (SOC 2, data residency, PII/redaction, AI data-usage questions); AI deals die here without it.
* Competitive positioning depth — knows the CCaaS/agent-assist landscape and can architect around a competitor's incumbency.
* POC discipline — scopes pilots with clear success criteria and exit dates, so pilots convert instead of drifting.

title: IT& Data D&A architect
description:
Expertise expected – Strong data & analytics architecture expertise with hands-on credibility on modern cloud platforms (e.g. Azure: ADF, Databricks, ADLS), lakehouse and distributed data processing – Mastery of ingestion/sharing patterns, data modeling and non-functional requirements (security, scalability, resilience) – Ability to reason across a product perimeter and to arbitrate complex, high-impact architecture decisions Leadership positioning – Proven experience steering external architects and deciding autonomously within standards – Excellent communication, stakeholder management and servant-leadership skills
  
  
Coverage, staffing & vendor management – Assign architects (mostly external) to products/squads based on demand, in a transversal (multi-product) mode — without dedicating an architect full-time to a single squad – Steer vendors: sourcing, scoping, deliverable quality, ramp-up/ramp-down and cost control – Anticipate architecture needs together with Product Owners and the Chapter Lead People leadership & capability building – Onboard, coach and upskill external architects; ensure continuity and knowledge transfer towards internal staff – Monitor vendor performance across the perimeter (quality, timeliness, compliance) Architecture governance (the “what”) – Accountable for solution architecture within guardrails, domain modeling and boundaries, integration patterns, solution security models and non-functional requirements – Own Architecture Decision Records (ADRs); chair the Solution Design Forum (SDF) as final decisionmaker (engineering input is consultative); escalate only strategic architecture decisions Standards adoption – Ensure solutions apply chapter standards, patterns and guardrails, and govern architectural exceptions Double-hatting (small perimeter) – Contribute directly as a Solution Architect (designs, ADRs), with cross-review to preserve the separation between producing and validating architecture decisions
  
  
A D&A Architecture Chapter Manager is the leader accountable, across a product perimeter, for architect coverage (mostly external), their steering, and the governance of the “what” of data solutions — owning the ADRs and chairing the Solution Design Forum — while applying (not defining) chapter standards. On a small perimeter, the role may double-hat as a D&A Solution Architect, with cross-review, until the perimeter grows beyond the defined threshold.

description:

We are seeking an experienced Blue Yonder (formerly JDA) ESP Solution Architect/Developer to lead the design, configuration, development and deployment of Enterprise Supply Planning solutions. This role will play a pivotal part in enabling global supply chain transformation by leveraging Blue Yonder’s advanced planning capabilities to optimize supply planning, inventory positioning, and production strategies. The candidate must be willing to work on site 4 days a week in Hyderabad, during US EST time zone.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture & Design**

* Lead and own the end-to-end architecture and design of Blue Yonder ESP (Enterprise Supply Planning) solutions.
* Translate business requirements into scalable solution designs that align with industry best practices and Blue Yonder's functional framework.
* Define planning models, network design, constraints, and heuristics aligned to business supply strategies.
* Expertise in interpreting solver results ensuring optimized planning quality based on constraints.

**Configuration & Development**

* Configure and develop components within Blue Yonder ESP, including supply planning, inventory balancing, pegging, and constraint-based planning logic.
* Customize ESP engines to align with business supply network models, demand signals, and production capacities.
* Create and manage planning parameters, supply chain hierarchies, and master data elements.

**Implementation & Configuration**

* Configure ESP modules including supply planning, constrained planning, and inventory optimization.
* Guide integration of ESP with up/downstream systems (Demand Planning, ERP, MRP, MES, Google Datalake).
* Oversee data modeling, master data configuration, and rule-based planning logic.

**Technical Leadership & Governance**

* Provide leadership and guidance to implementation teams and technical consultants.
* Review and approve functional and technical design documents.
* Ensure adherence to Blue Yonder standards and change management protocols.

**Business Collaboration & Change Enablement**

* Collaborate with business stakeholders across supply chain, manufacturing, and IT to gather requirements and align solution outcomes.
* Conduct design workshops, walkthroughs, and training sessions to ensure knowledge transfer and user adoption.
* Act as the primary point of contact for solution design decisions and issue resolution.

**Continuous Improvement & Support**

* Identify and propose enhancements for planning performance, configuration, or data integration.
* Support hypercare and transition to steady-state planning operations.
* Evaluate emerging Blue Yonder capabilities and industry trends to evolve the planning landscape.
* Contribute to production support and documenting processes and facilitating enablement sessions to empower stakeholders with the necessary skills and knowledge to utilize BY ESP solutions effectively.

**Qualifications**

* Education Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
* Experience 10+ years of experience in supply chain planning, with at least 5+ years in Blue Yonder ESP architecture or implementation.
* Technical Skills Hands-on expertise in configuring, designing and deploying Blue Yonder ESP modules (Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, S&OP, Manufacturing Planning) solutions and managing Control-M with extensive experience of MAP solver and ability to understand and interpret solver output ensuring optimal planning results. Strong understanding of planning algorithms (constrained/unconstrained), pegging, and network optimization. Scripting (e.g., PL/SQL, Python, or batch scripting) skill is a must. Experience with integration to ERP systems like SAP, Oracle, or Infor. Familiarity with data integration tools (e.g., SAP PI, MuleSoft, Informatica) and batch/scheduled data feeds.
* Leadership Skills Excellent communication, leadership, and client-facing skills.
* Problem-Solving Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to addressing challenges.
* Cultural Awareness Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and highly dynamic environment and manage teams across different time zones. Must be multi-tasker and able to prioritize and deliver assignments with the highest quality under pressure with short deadlines.
* Blue Yonder certification in ESP or SCPO suite is highly desirable.
* Experience in scripting (e.g., PL/SQL, Python, or batch scripting) is a significant advantage especially OIL scripts.
* Experience in deploying complex BOM, Load building planning, dynamic deployment functionality is highly preferred.
* Experience in SPARQ solver is a plus.
* Experience in large-scale global supply chain transformation programs.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid implementation methodologies.
* Knowledge of other Blue Yonder modules (Demand Planning, Sequencing, Control Tower) is a plus.
* Knowledge of Anaplan (planning) models is a plus.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
  
  
**How We Work**
We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors
  
  

* We collaborate Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* We innovate At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* We execute We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. title: Principal Firmware Engineer (Security)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Principal Firmware Engineer to manage a talented team while remaining a highly hands-on technical contributor. You will lead the design, development, and optimization of highly secure embedded systems. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Secure Boot, attestation schemes such as SPDM, secure provisioning, cryptographic firmware signing, and key/certificate revocation mechanisms, alongside strong knowledge of RTOS, Linux kernels, device drivers, and bus protocols. This "player-coach" role requires exceptional problem-solving skills to diagnose and resolve complex hardware-security interactions, as well as the leadership abilities to guide, mentor, and manage a high-performing engineering team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Team Management & Hands-On Contribution: Lead, manage, and grow a team of firmware engineers while remaining a core individual contributor. Dedicate a significant portion of your time to writing code, conducting code reviews, and resolving low-level technical challenges.
* Security Architecture & Boot Flow: Architect, develop, and optimize embedded software solutions with a primary focus on end-to-end platform security, including Secure Boot, hardware Root of Trust (RoT), and verified boot pipelines.
* Protocols & Provisioning: Implement and manage attestation schemes such as SPDM for device authentication and remote measurement, alongside secure factory and field secure provisioning workflows.
* Firmware Signing & Lifecycle Management: Design and maintain cryptographic firmware signing infrastructure, secure update pipelines, and robust revocation mechanisms (such as anti-rollback counters, key revocation lists, and certificate revocation).
* Debugging & Security Analysis: Diagnose and resolve complex hardware/software and cryptographic failure modes using advanced debugging tools (JTAG, GDB, logic analyzers).
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with security experts, hardware engineers, and system architects to define roadmaps and deliver scalable embedded security solutions, while contributing to open-source security standards or embedded projects.

**Job Requirements**
**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Experience: 20+ years of experience in embedded software development, featuring a strong foundational background in C/C++.

* Team Leadership: Proven track record of managing and leading engineering teams while maintaining an active, hands-on role in software development and system architecture.
* Security Expertise:

+ Proven experience with Secure Boot, Root of Trust (RoT), and cryptographic security principles (symmetric/asymmetric cryptography, hashing, digital signatures).
+ Hands-on implementation experience with attestation schemes such as SPDM for hardware authentication and platform measurement.
+ In-depth knowledge of secure provisioning methodologies, HSM (Hardware Security Module) integration, and secure key storage.
+ Robust understanding of firmware signing workflows and lifecycle revocation architectures (e.g., CRLs, embedded validation, fuse-based key revocation).

* System Software & Hardware: Extensive experience with RTOS, Linux kernel, device drivers, and hardware bring-up using Board Support Packages (BSPs).
* Protocols & Interfaces: Strong grasp of peripheral interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, USB) and bus protocols (PCIe, Ethernet), with PCIe root port and SR-IOV knowledge being a strong plus.
* Toolchains & Build Systems: Familiarity with Linux build frameworks such as Yocto and Buildroot, alongside low-level debugging via JTAG and GDB.
* Preferred Domains: Experience with Baseboard Management Controllers (BMC) and hardware security accelerators.

**Application Procedure**

title: Senior Manager, AI Enablement Engineering
description:

Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. This role leads the development and adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities across the product development lifecycle. It combines hands-on technical leadership with responsibility for guiding a small team of highly technical professionals. The role partners with product managers, engineering leaders, architects, and global technology teams to build, experiment with, and deploy AI tools and practices that help teams deliver products faster and with greater quality. The successful candidate will bring strong architecture and engineering experience, remain actively involved in technical work, and operate as a player-coach rather than as a traditional program manager.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance, coaching, and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.

* Drives the application of AI across the full product development lifecycle, from idea and discovery through architecture, engineering, testing, implementation, production deployment, and continuous improvement.
* Leads as a player-coach by directing a small team of highly technical professionals toward the highest-value opportunities while remaining actively involved in solution design and building.
* Partners with product managers, engineering leaders, architects, and technology teams in India and the United States to co-build solutions and deploy AI-enabled tools and practices.

* Coaches product and engineering teams on the effective adoption of AI tools, practices, and reusable components to improve development speed, quality, and outcomes.
* Provides technical oversight and promotes sound architecture, engineering standards, risk awareness, controls, and responsible implementation of AI-enabled capabilities.
* Builds and maintains strategic relationships across sites, departments, divisions, and internal and external partners to support enterprise adoption and delivery.
* Communicates technical direction, progress, decisions, risks, and outcomes clearly to technical teams, product partners, and senior leadership.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in information technology, software engineering, architecture, or product development, with experience across the full product development lifecycle.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven experience as a hands-on technical lead, solution architect, engineering architect, principal engineer, senior engineer, or equivalent technical leader.
* Practical proficiency with AI-native engineering tools and approaches. Experience with Claude Code or comparable AI coding assistants, including plugins, integrations, interfaces, reusable skills, or related development ecosystems, is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to contribute directly to technical design, system architecture, prototypes, code, integrations, or production-oriented solutions.
* Strong understanding of modern software architecture, system design, engineering practices, product delivery, implementation, and production operations.
* Experience leading or guiding a small, highly technical team while remaining actively involved in technical work.
* Ability to identify and apply emerging AI capabilities to build faster, better, and more effective products.
* Strong learning agility and curiosity, with a consistent focus on staying current in a rapidly evolving AI environment.
* Self-driven and execution-oriented approach, with the ability to take ideas from exploration through experimentation, implementation, and adoption.
* Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, collaboration, and verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively across functions and geographies and to partner with product, engineering, architecture, and leadership teams.
* Experience in financial services or another highly regulated enterprise environment is preferred.
* This role is best suited to a current hands-on technical leader. Profiles focused primarily on project or program management, Agile coaching, Scrum leadership, or long-term people management without recent technical contribution may not align with the role.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: O+O Engineering lead
description:
**Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!**
**Who Are We?**
For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  
For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L’Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty.
  
  
Today, L’Oréal includes more than 2,000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.
  
  
Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L’Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure.
  
  
**A Day in the Life of O+O Engineering lead!**
We are looking for an experienced and collaborative Engineering Lead to join the L'Oréal Hyderabad Tech Hub. In this strategic role, you will act as the key technical bridge between our global O+O CTO organization in Paris and the delivery teams in Hyderabad, while animating the platform engineering teams across zones in ITH.
  
  
Your core mission will be to contribute to, roll out, and drive the adoption of existing or in-progress O+O standards, platforms, and AISDLC …
  
  
You will collaborate closely with global teams to ensure successful implementation, continuous improvement, and local alignment.
  
  
Beyond driving these rollouts, you will be a hands-on leader responsible for building, recruiting, and mentoring a high-performing team (DevOps, Developers, and Engineers) based in Hyderabad to execute this transformation at scale.
  
  
**In this role, You will..**
**Be Responsible For The Following**
As O+O ITH Engineering lead, you will lead the software execution layer of our Beauty Tech and Online & OmniSales ambition for the programs delivered in India Tech Hub. Your role will be to turn project visions into robust, secure, scalable applications & platforms that can be activated globally by our brands, markets, and partners. You will directly contribute to accelerating our insourcing strategy, strengthening our engineering excellence, and building sustainable systems capable of supporting omnichannel, personalized experiences with strong business impact.
  
  
You will lead the implementation of the platform engineering spirit, tooling and patterns into our ITH squads, in alignment with our Global CTO technological strategy.
  
  
**In This Position Your Main Mission Will Be**

* Engineering mission and leadership:

+ Contribute to the engineering vision in line with the Group’s business and technology strategy, and lead its implementation through a distributed, multicultural organization.
+ As well as to the continuous improvement, deployment, and local enforcement of standardized delivery processes, tools, and best practices across all O+O (Online + Offline) programs.

* Platform Engineering:

+ Drive the adoption and scaling of the AI SDLC framework within ITH, integrating AI-driven tools and automation across software development phases in alignment with global guidelines.
+ Support innovation by leveraging generative AI and machine learning capabilities provided by global platforms to accelerate delivery cycles and improve code quality.
+ Deploy Group solutions for End-to-end observability & Smart Ops
+ Drive the roll-out, adoption, and local improvements of existing global platforms (such as the IDP - Internal Developer Portal ) for tracking and analyzing Value Creation.

* Architecture and industrialization:

+ Contribute to architecture choices and engineering standards to ensure performance, resilience, security, scalability, and maintainability in modern, distributed cloud environments.
+ Be the Gatekeeper for architectural decisions & tracking in partnership with the Global CTO team

* End-to-end delivery:

+ Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from design to production release, accelerating the transformation of ideas, AI use cases, and product innovations into solutions deployed at scale.
+ Monitor key engineering metrics, team velocity, and delivery efficiency using standard tooling, providing transparent insights to leadership in both Hyderabad and Paris.

* Transformation through GenAI: Make GenAI a concrete lever for engineering productivity and quality by scaling development copilots, test automation, documentation assistance, assisted refactoring, and the continuous improvement of delivery practices.
* Operational excellence: Strengthen DevSecOps, SRE, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code practices to ensure fast, safe, frequent deployments and a high level of availability for critical services.
* Culture and talent: Build a demanding engineering culture based on clarity, ownership, simplicity, and impact, while attracting, developing, and retaining technical talent as part of an insourcing and team scale-up strategy.
* Cross-functional partnership:

+ Act as a strategic partner to Product, Architecture, Data, Design, and application domain teams to turn business needs into clear, well-arbitrated technical decisions that create value for brands and markets.
+ Ensure seamless collaboration and alignment between local delivery execution in Hyderabad and global architectural standards defined by the O+O CTO team in Paris.

**What are we looking for?**

* Experience: 10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, with at least 3–5 years in a technical leadership or delivery management role within a matrix organization.
* Tech Skills

+ Proficiency in GCP and Azure environments with ability to design & implement cloud native architectures
+ Good knowledge of web development technologies & architectures (React, Vue, Node )
+ DevSecOps : ability to design end-to-end CICD pipelines : tests, build, security audit (Checkmarx ), code quality audit (SonarQube ), Infra as Code ( Terraform )
+ Vector, Hybrid and Graph RAG and their usual databases (Pinecone, Neo4j, TigerDB, GraphDB, PostgreSQL+pgvector). Re-ranking strategies, retrieval pipelines, Hybrid Symbolic & Neural systems
+ Tool calling, agent orchestration ( LangGraph / Langchain / Langsmith, MCP / MCP-UI, DSPy, A2A, A2UI)
+ Data Engineering (Delta Architectures, Lambda Architectures, Medaillon pattern, BigQuery, Databricks Lakehouse, Dagster / Airflow / Prefect)
+ MLOps (VertexAI, MLFlow)

* Leadership style

+ Ability to navigate a matrix organization, influence and collaborate with peers (Marketing, Product, Design, Advanced Engineering)
+ Calm, clear, and demanding - in the best sense
+ Able to simplify without being simplistic
+ Respected by senior engineers and product leaders
+ Comfortable making and explaining hard trade-offs

* Mindset

+ You believe that simple systems are hard to build, but worth it
+ You optimize for long-term leverage, not short-term heroics
+ You care deeply about craft, but even more about impact
+ Collaborative, structured, results-oriented, and adaptable.

* Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent English communication skills; capable of navigating a matrix organization with dual reporting lines between local management (India) and global leadership (Paris).

**What’s In It for You?**

* Working with cutting edge Technology, empowering employees with new age learning, global exposure, and opportunities to build future-ready careers.
* A flexible and modern workplace, enabling teams to perform at their best through a smart hybrid model that supports balance and autonomy. A 3 Day in Office, 2 Day Work from Home setup.
* Employee support at every life stage, with inclusive and progressive parental policies that help individuals and families thrive.
* Holistic wellbeing offerings - personalized health benefits and strong mental wellness support to ensure employees feel their best.
* Reward and Recognition opportunities, long-term incentives, and opportunities to share in L’Oréal’s collective success.
* L'Oreal is an Equal Opportunity Employer and takes pride in a diverse environment

**Good to know: The Recruitment Process**

* Interview with HR
* Technical Interview
* Interview with the hiring manager

We would love to find out more about you as a candidate and we do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices. The beauty we find in our differences gives us the freedom to go beyond. That’s the beauty of L’Oréal.

* Build and maintain strong partnerships with global stakeholders, effectively communicating technical strategy, project risks, and delivery outcomes.

* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, maintainability, and overall software quality across the engineering organization.
* Contribute to strategic technology roadmaps and support the adoption of emerging technologies.
* Participate in special projects and additional leadership initiatives as needed.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading technical teams.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Job Title: Platform Engineer

Location: Hyderabad

Experience: 3+ Years

Job Type: Full time/ Permanent

Notice Period: Immediate to 60 days

***About AssetMark***

AssetMark is a leading wealth management platform dedicated to empowering independent financial advisors. AssetMark's mission is to enable financial advisors to make a profound difference in the lives of their clients. Over 10,000 advisors partner with AssetMark for our investment offerings, innovative technology, advanced services, and expertise, which they use to delight their clients and grow their businesses. We are an integrated team of technologists, investment professionals, and operations experts working together to advance wealth management.

***The Opportunity***

We are seeking a Platform Engineer to lead the design and implementation of mission-critical platform systems, APIs, and foundational architecture. This senior role involves owning significant platform capabilities, driving architectural decisions, and establishing technical standards that enable our entire engineering organization. You'll work on transformational platform initiatives while mentoring other engineers and ensuring our technology foundation scales with business growth.

This role is based in Hyderabad and follows a hybrid work model. You will collaborate with colleagues across India and the United States, with reasonable working-hour overlap when needed for team ceremonies, planning, and delivery. This is an excellent change to be part of building a new Global Capability Center and shaping an engineering and product culture based on deep partnership and ownership.

***Key Responsibilities***

***Platform Architecture & Design***

Design and implement mission-critical platform features and foundational systems

Shape platform architecture through both written specifications and hands-on code implementation

Build and maintain frameworks that make software development easier for application teams

Drive AssetMark towards target platform architecture through strategic technical decisions

Author technical design documents for complex platform capabilities

Advanced Platform Development

Create enterprise-scale solutions for data management, API governance, and service integration

Implement large-scale refactoring initiatives to improve platform code quality and performance

Build canonical source-of-truth data systems with robust governance and compliance capabilities

Design and implement standardized patterns for service integration and cross-application workflows

Establish and enforce API design principles, versioning strategies, and governance models

Technical Leadership & Standards

Improve platform development practices and processes across multiple teams

Teach other engineers effective platform development and code review techniques

Help establish platform community practices around secure coding, data privacy, and design standards

Balance technical debt with platform evolution while maintaining enterprise reliability

Coordinate platform work across multiple development teams and resolve complex technical dependencies

***Enterprise & Compliance***

Ensure platform architecture meets stringent security, compliance, and regulatory requirements

Design systems that support business growth and can scale to enterprise demands

Work with data governance policies and master data management principles

Support technology modernization initiatives and legacy system transformation

Collaborate with enterprise architecture and security teams on strategic platform decisions

***Knowledge, Skills, Abilities***

Deep expertise in platform engineering, API design, and service-oriented architectures

Experience with Java, Spring Boot, Liquibase, SQL Server or Postgres, REST services with JSON payloads, Azure (e.g. API Management, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid), Redis and/or Snowflake is a plus.

Advanced understanding of cloud-native development, microservices, and distributed systems

Strong background in data architecture, enterprise integration patterns, and event-driven systems

Experience with performance optimization, scalability engineering, and system reliability

Knowledge of DevOps, infrastructure-as-code, and modern deployment practices

Understanding of enterprise security, compliance, and regulatory requirements

Proven ability to drive architectural decisions and influence technical direction

Strong mentorship skills and experience leading complex technical initiatives

Ability to collaborate effectively in a hybrid, globally distributed engineering organization and communicate across technical and business teams

***Qualifications & Experience***

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field

3-5 years of software engineering experience with significant platform engineering focus

Experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale platform systems

Track record of leading complex technical initiatives and mentoring other engineers

Experience with regulated industries, preferably financial services

Strong background in API governance, data architecture, and enterprise integration

***Why Join AssetMark?***

Lead development of foundational platform capabilities that power the entire AssetMark ecosystem

Drive architectural decisions that shape the future of wealth management technology infrastructure

Work on transformational initiatives in a growth-oriented, private equity-backed environment

Mentor engineering talent and establish technical standards across the organization

Significant impact on technology strategy and platform evolution in the fintech space

***Our Commitment***

AssetMark values diversity of thought and background and is committed to building an inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including those who are traditionally underrepresented in technology.

Employment is subject to applicable local requirements and successful completion of AssetMark’s hiring process

This role works with customers, business leaders, AI teams, and engineering teams. The Data Architect will assess the current data landscape, define the target-state architecture and roadmap, and set the standards for data lakes, warehouses, lakehouses, and AI-ready data layers. The person will own the architecture decisions and will also work hands-on during design, proofs of concept, and critical build phases.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work with customer business and technology stakeholders to understand business processes, AI use cases, analytics needs, and reporting requirements.
* Assess current data sources, platforms, data quality, integration gaps, and AI/analytics readiness, and present findings with recommendations.
* Define the target-state data architecture and a phased data foundation roadmap for AI and analytics programs.

* Design data architecture for GenAI use cases, including RAG pipelines, document ingestion, chunking and embedding strategy, vector stores, and grounding data for copilots and AI agents.
* Define standards for data security, access control, privacy, metadata, cataloging, lineage, and governance, using tools such as Microsoft Purview and Unity Catalog.
* Set frameworks for data quality, reconciliation, validation, error handling, observability, and pipeline monitoring.
* Make platform and tool choices (Fabric vs. Databricks vs. Synapse, storage formats, compute sizing) and keep cost, performance, and scalability in balance.
* Build reference architectures, reusable templates, and accelerators, and contribute hands-on to POCs and complex pipeline or model development using SQL, Python, and PySpark.
* Review designs and code from data engineers and guide the engineering team on architecture standards and best practices.
* Lead pre-sales architecture work, including customer discovery, solution design, RFP responses, effort estimation, and proposal content for Data + AI programs.
* Present architecture, implementation approach, risks, and roadmap clearly to customer executives and internal leadership.

**Required Skills**

* 12+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, or data architecture, with at least 4 years in an architect role.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise data lakes, data warehouses, or lakehouse platforms end to end.
* Deep expertise in the Microsoft data ecosystem: Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Synapse, Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse), Databricks, Azure SQL, and Power BI.
* Strong data modeling skills, including dimensional modeling (Kimball), Data Vault, and semantic model design.
* Strong SQL plus working hands-on skills in Python and PySpark.
* Experience defining data governance, security, metadata, and lineage frameworks.
* Experience with integration patterns across APIs, databases, files, and enterprise applications.
* Ability to translate business and AI use cases into architecture, data requirements, and delivery roadmaps.
* Experience leading data engineering teams and setting technical direction across projects.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and executive stakeholder management skills.

**Good to Have**

Someone who can sit with customer leadership, understand the business and AI use cases, assess what the data foundation is missing, design the target architecture and roadmap, and then guide the team (and step in hands-on when needed) to build the platform, pipelines, models, and AI-ready datasets.
