**• Establish software architecture principles, coding standards, interface standards and engineering processes.** 




**• Ensure bidirectional traceability between system requirements, software requirements, design, source code and verification results.** 




**• Prepare and review Software Development Plans, Software Quality Assurance Plans, Interface Control Documents, Verification and Validation Plans and software release documentation.** 




**• Solid Understanding of STANAG, DEF STAN, IEEE and NATO interoperability requirements.** 




**• Support software safety assessment, hazard analysis, design assurance and preparation of certification evidence.** 




**• Architect the integration and deployment of machine\-learning models within operational software.** 




**• Lead architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews and technical risk assessments.** 




**• Take responsibility for product performance, reliability, cybersecurity, maintainability and long\-term support.** 




  





**Mandatory Defence and Standards Experience.** 




  





**The candidate must have practical experience with:** 




**•  Battle Management Systems, Combat Management Systems \& C4I Platforms** 




**•  Capability to interpret, develop and implement Interface Control Documents (ICDs)** 
 for integrating military sensors, equipment and external subsystems
 



 •  
 **DEF STAN 00\-55** 
 – Safety of Programmable Elements in Defence Systems.
 



 •  D
 **EF STAN 00\-56** 
 – Safety Management Requirements for Defence Systems.
 



 •  IEEE/ISO/IEC 12207 software lifecycle processes.
 



 •  Software Quality Assurance Plans, configuration management plans and certification documentation.
 



 •  Requirements traceability, design assurance, verification and validation.
 



 •  Relevant STANAGs and NATO interoperability standards.
 



 •  Preparing objective evidence for audits, qualification and customer acceptance.
 



 Experience with DEF STAN 00\-40, DEF STAN 00\-42 and DEF STAN 00\-600 is desirable.
 



 Software Architecture and Engineering Skills
 



 •  Strong architecture experience with distributed, event\-driven and real\-time software systems.
 



 •  Strong programming experience in C\+\+ and/or Java or C\#, with working knowledge of Python.
 



 •  Linux\-based application development, system services, process management and performance optimization.
 



 • Multithreading, concurrency, inter\-process communication and deterministic data processing.
 



 • Network programming using TCP/IP, UDP, multicast, serial communication and message\-oriented middleware.
 



 • Strong understanding of design patterns, modular architecture, service\-oriented architecture and microservices where operationally appropriate.
 



 • High availability, redundancy, failover, health monitoring and graceful degradation.
 



 • Secure coding, authentication, authorization, encryption, audit logging and cybersecurity hardening.
 



 • Offline and disconnected operations in bandwidth\-constrained defence environments.
 



  





**Machine\-Learning Skills** 




  





**• Experience integrating computer vision, detection, classification, tracking or decision\-support models into production products.** 




**• Model conversion and optimized inference using ONNX and hardware\-specific inference engines.** 




**• Deployment on GPU and edge\-computing platforms.** 




**• Understanding of model validation, dataset versioning, performance benchmarking and inference monitoring.** 




**• Ability to define controlled fallback behaviour when an ML model produces uncertain or invalid results.** 




**• Experience maintaining traceability between model versions, datasets, software releases and operational performance.** 




**Development and Engineering Tools** 




**The candidate should have hands\-on experience with:** 




**• Containers: Docker and container orchestration where appropriate.** 




**• Dynamic analysis: Valgrind, sanitizers, profiling and memory\-analysis tools.** 




**• Interface testing: Wireshark, protocol simulators, equipment emulators and hardware\-in\-the\-loop test environments.** 




**• Observability: Structured logging, and system\-health monitoring.** 




**• Documentation: Controlled requirements, architecture, interface, test and release documentation with complete traceability.** 




**• ML lifecycle: MLflow, DVC or equivalent model and dataset version\-control tools.** 




  





**Qualifications:** 




  





**• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.** 




**• Minimum 10 years of direct software product engineering and delivery experience.** 




**• Demonstrated ownership of at least one complete mission\-critical or defence software product lifecycle.** 




**• Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across software, electronics, systems engineering, testing and field integration.** 




**• Strong written and verbal communication skills for working with customers, certification authorities, military users and equipment OEMs.** 




**Mandatory Eligibility Conditions** 




**• Candidates with less than 10 years of relevant software product delivery experience will not be considered.** 




**• Consultants, independent advisors and candidates with predominantly consulting or advisory experience will not be considered.** 




**• The candidate must demonstrate direct, hands\-on responsibility for architecture, engineering, integration, qualification and operational delivery of software products.** 




**•           General enterprise IT architecture experience without defence, naval, industrial control or comparable mission\-critical product experience will not meet the requirements of this position.**

title: Senior Data Architect
description:
**Job Location**
 HYDERABAD OFFICE INDIA PSC PGH
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Family Summary:
   

  

 P\&G was founded over 180 years ago as a simple soap and candle company. Today, we're the world’s largest consumer goods company and home to iconic, trusted brands that make life a little bit easier in small but meaningful ways. We've spanned three centuries thanks to three simple ideas: leadership, innovation and citizenship. The insight, innovation and passion of hardworking teams have helped us grow into a global company that is governed responsibly and ethically, that is open and visible, and that supports good causes and protects the environment. This is a place where you can be proud to work and do something that matters.
   

  

**Dedication from Us:** 
 You'll be at the core of breakthrough innovations, be given exciting assignments, lead initiatives, and take ownership and responsibility, in creative workspaces where new insights thrive. All the while, you'll receive outstanding training to help you become a leader in your field. It is not just about what you'll do, but how you'll feel: encouraged, valued, purposeful, challenged, heard, and inspired.
   

  

**What we Offer:** 
 Continuous mentorship – you will collaborate with peers and receive both formal training as well as day\-to\-day mentoring from your manager dynamic and encouraging work environment– employees are at the center, we value every individual and support initiative, promoting agility and work/life balance.
   

  

 The Data Architecture job family involves leading the data design for an application, solution, or business domain, helping to define how data will flow, and be stored and structured.
   

  

 We are looking for an Architect to join our Supply Chain Innovation organization and lead the design of enterprise\-scale Generative AI solutions that run on top of P\&G's data platform. At P\&G, AI is not a standalone experiment — it is an operational interface over the data that runs our business, from supply chain and vendor systems to retail distribution and consumer insights. In this role you will own the architecture for how our AI systems retrieve, reason over, and act on enterprise data, working hands\-on while setting the standards other engineering teams build against. This is an exciting opportunity for a self\-motivated architect who enjoys solving complex technical problems and delivering high\-impact global solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end architecture for enterprise GenAI solutions — retrieval, orchestration, integration, and evaluation — ensuring they are scalable, secure, and aligned to business outcomes.
* Design production retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) architectures over enterprise data, including document ingestion and chunking, indexing strategy, hybrid lexical and semantic retrieval, re\-ranking, and relevance tuning.
* Architect multi\-phase agent and tool\-calling workflows with deterministic guardrails — scoped tool access, structured output schemas, validation, bounded retries, explicit completion contracts, and fallback handling — so that non\-deterministic models meet production reliability standards.
* Design the data ingestion and synchronization foundations that support AI grounding — streaming and change data capture from enterprise sources, canonical data models, and incremental sync that keeps indexes and downstream systems current.
* Enforce data governance and strict multi\-tenant isolation boundaries across brands, regions, and partners, applying access control, PII protection, and Responsible AI principles by default.
* Establish evaluation and observability standards for AI workloads — curated test sets, automated quality scoring including model\-based judging, regression suites in CI/CD, and end\-to\-end tracing of model behavior in production.
* Own the operational economics of AI systems: latency and throughput targets, inference and token cost management, caching strategies, and routing work to the appropriate model for the task.
* Act as the principal technical authority for AI architecture — lead design reviews, resolve complex performance and integration issues, mentor engineers, and champion Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD practices.


 Ideal Candidate:
   

  

* A hands\-on architect who can independently design end\-to\-end solutions while remaining active in development, code review, and production problem\-solving.
* Treats AI systems as distributed data systems — designs for failure, latency, duplication, and drift rather than assuming the happy path.
* Collaborative and self\-motivated, able to work across global teams, influence stakeholders without formal authority, and translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.


**About Us**
 We produce globally recognized brands, and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head \& Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral\-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.
   

  

 Visit http://www.pg.com to know more.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor
   

  

**Job Qualifications**
 Job Qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, with a significant focus on architecture and technical leadership of large\-scale, multi\-tenant, or high\-throughput platforms.
* Hands\-on experience designing and delivering production Generative AI solutions — retrieval\-augmented generation, LLM\-based classification and extraction, or multi\-phase agent workflows — including the schema validation, guardrails, and fallback logic that make them dependable.
* Proven experience architecting orchestration layers for distributed systems — event\-driven and streaming pipelines, workflow and state management, idempotency, bounded retries, and recovery from partial failure — and applying the same discipline to AI and agent workflows.
* Strong grounding in search and retrieval: inverted indexes and lexical relevance scoring, vector and semantic similarity, hybrid retrieval and rank fusion, re\-ranking, and the effect of data freshness on retrieval quality.
* Experience defining quality and evaluation practices for probabilistic systems — curated test sets, regression suites, automated and model\-based scoring of output quality, and production tracing.
* Experience integrating heterogeneous enterprise systems and data sources at scale across streaming, API, and file\-based patterns, with strong data modeling and schema governance instincts.
* programming skills in at least one backend language (Python, Node.js/TypeScript, or similar), with hands\-on experience across document and relational data stores.
* Cloud\-native engineering experience (Azure) with containerization, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and observability as default practice.
* Ability to lead technical design discussions, drive solution decisions, and operate as a hands\-on technical lead within cross\-functional and global teams.
* Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.


 Preferred: Working knowledge of modern lakehouse platforms (Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) and medallion data architectures; familiarity with AI governance, guardrails, and evaluation tooling; experience integrating enterprise systems; experience designing for regulated or highly sensitive data environments.
   

  

**Job Schedule**
 Full time
   

  

**Job Number**
 R000159260
   

  

**Job Segmentation**
 Experienced Professionals

title: Solution Architect, ISV, AGS-APJ-India-ISV-SA
description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
   

  

 You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
   

  

 As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 In this role, your technical depth, business aptitude, and ability to steer technology discussions at all levels will enable you to shape the customer journey. Your thought leadership, ability to look beyond the technology, and more holistically at the value technology creates for our customers, is crucial to your success.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers, AWS and partners, and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. You will go beyond the technical solution architecture, work with partners, sellers and specialists to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology.
   

  

**About The Team**
 This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India, working with the customers to help drive AWS services adoption.
   

  

**About AWS**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 2\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

title: Software Development Manager, FinTech General Ledger
description:
**Description**
 We're looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead one of the engineering teams responsible for Amazon's General Ledger (GL) and financial close systems — the mission\-critical technology that accurately accounts for approximately 900 million transactions per month across the entire company. This is a rare opportunity to lead at the center of a multi\-year financial transformation: re\-architecting how Amazon runs its General Ledger and closes its books, and building the next generation of these systems for 2028 and beyond.
   

  

 You'll lead a team of software engineers who own critical parts of the close lifecycle — spanning sub\-ledger integration, journal and ledger processing, and close orchestration — delivering high\-impact automation for our Finance and Global Business Services (FGBS) customers. As close timelines compress and expectations for accuracy and speed rise, your team's work directly shapes the confidence Amazon has in its financial numbers, at scale.
   

  

 This role is defined by change. Amazon's General Ledger is being re\-built and its surrounding processes redesigned end to end — close calendars are shortening, manual touchpoints are being engineered out, and the target\-state architecture is being built now. You will operate with significant autonomy to set technical strategy, make architectural decisions that carry across the current and future state, and lead your team through the transition without compromising the reliability of a system that cannot fail during close.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise in large\-scale distributed systems, preferably a background in financial or ERP systems, and a proven ability to lead teams through ambiguous, high\-stakes transformation while keeping production healthy. You work backwards from customer needs, you're comfortable when both the business problem and the technology approach require invention, and you can hold a long\-term vision while shipping incremental value every sprint. You'll partner closely with finance, controllership, product, and technology stakeholders to translate complex accounting requirements into scalable, automation\-first solutions.
   

  

 If you're energized by leading a team that is redefining the future of Amazon's General Ledger — modernizing the technology, compressing the close, and building toward a touchless, self\-healing future state — we want to hear from you.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead architecture, design, and delivery of GL and close systems, making technical decisions that balance near\-term reliability with the long\-term target state
* Define and drive the technical vision and roadmap for your team, working backwards from FGBS customer needs and the broader GL modernization program
* Guide your team through system and process transformation — sequencing migration, modernization, and automation work while protecting the integrity and timeliness of every close
* Build, mentor, and manage a high\-performing team of software engineers, fostering a culture of automation\-first thinking and technical excellence
* Own operational metrics and system health for GL and close systems, establishing mechanisms to monitor progress and drive continuous improvement
* Partner with finance, controllership, and product teams to translate complex accounting requirements into scalable technical solutions
* Recruit, hire, and develop top engineering talent, creating clear career paths and coaching that helps your team grow
* Champion automation and rapid iteration, continuously eliminating manual touchpoints to shorten Amazon's financial close timeline


**About The Team**
 We are the engineering organization behind Amazon's General Ledger and month\-end close — one of the most complex and high\-stakes financial processes in the company. Our teams own the timely and accurate closure of sub\-ledgers and the General Ledger, ensuring that approximately 900 million transactions per month are accounted for with precision, along with the foundational GL functions — ledger setups, posting and recurring schedules, journal processing, and close orchestration — that keep Amazon's financial engine running.
   

  

 What sets us apart is a relentless drive toward automation and modernization. We are actively building the next generation of Amazon's General Ledger and redesigning the close processes around it, with the goal of a faster, more resilient, and ultimately touchless close. Every sprint moves us closer to that future state — and this role helps lead the way there.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of engineering experience
* 3\+ years of engineering team management experience
* 8\+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

**Position Summary:**

****Role Summary****
 We are seeking an AI Solutions Architect to design and deliver production\-grade AI agent platforms. You will own the architecture from LLM prompt design to multi\-tenancy and vendor integration across HR platforms (Workday, SAP, Oracle HCM). * Design vendor integration patterns using direct APIs, MCP, and A2A protocol for complex HR platform workflows.

* Working knowledge of multi\-tenant security patterns
* (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, or equivalent) for architecture work, design documentation, and engineering workflows. Familiarity with agentic engineering patterns is expected.

****Preferred Qualifications****
* Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) protocol for vendor and cross\-system integrations.
* Experience integrating with HR/HCM platforms
* Experience with LangFuse, LangSmith, or similar LLM observability and tracing platforms.
* Knowledge of responsible AI practices: PII handling, prompt injection defense, model risk management, and explainability.
* — working familiarity with cloud\-native deployment (Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC, observability), data engineering patterns (ETL/ELT, lakehouse, streaming), and the operational implications for AI platforms. * Architecture leadership with pragmatic trade\-off decisions (speed vs. risk, cost vs. accuracy, build vs. buy, direct integration vs. protocol abstraction).

* Strong ownership mindset for reliability, security, and operational excellence.

 The Solution Architect — Marketing Cloud Next is the primary client\-facing technical authority for migrations from legacy marketing automation platforms — Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, legacy Salesforce Marketing Cloud Classic — to Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Salesforce Data Cloud. This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy and technical platform design: owning the end\-to\-end solution blueprint, leading functional discovery workshops, translating complex marketing business requirements into a Salesforce MCN solution architecture, and governing the functional quality of deliverables across the migration wave.
   

  

 Solution Architect owns the solution strategy, functional design and client relationship — ensuring the migrated platform delivers the business outcomes the client's marketing operations, CRM and digital teams need, while the Technical Architect delivers the technical implementation. Together with the Data Cloud Architect, the SA ensures migrated subscriber data, consent records and journey logic land in a well\-governed, AI\-ready, unified customer platform that sets the client up for Agentforce personalisation and Data Cloud activation post go\-live.

* Author the migration approach document — defining the phased migration strategy, wave sequencing, subscriber migration methodology, journey migration priority framework, legacy platform deprecation schedule and business cutover approach with go/no\-go criteria.
* Design the subscriber data migration strategy — at the functional level: defining which subscriber segments migrate, the business rules governing data transformation, suppression list governance, consent record mapping requirements and the subscriber validation criteria the business will use to sign off each data wave.

* Manage scope and functional sign\-off — maintaining the solution scope register, managing scope change requests, producing functional design documents and obtaining formal business sign\-off at each MDLC phase gate before the Technical Architect begins build.
* Serve as Trusted Advisor to the client — building long\-term relationships with client marketing technology leads, digital directors, CDOs and Enterprise Architects; providing candid guidance on MCN platform capabilities, migration trade\-offs and post\-migration marketing strategy.
* Govern functional quality of deliverables — reviewing all functional design documents, process maps, data mapping sheets, journey design artefacts and user acceptance test scripts produced by the track team to ensure they meet factory quality standards and client expectations.
* Validate business process equivalence post\-migration — leading user acceptance testing (UAT) planning, supporting client business users through UAT execution, managing defect triage and confirming that migrated journeys, subscriber segments and send logic deliver the same business outcomes as the legacy platform.
* Lead email deliverability strategy — advising on IP warm\-up planning, domain authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), sender reputation management and inbox placement testing strategy post\-migration.
* Contribute to the Migration Factory — building reusable MCN solution design templates, discovery workshop guides, journey migration assessment frameworks, consent architecture blueprints and migration approach documents for the factory accelerator library.
* Support pre\-sales and solutioning — contributing to proposal development, migration scope estimation, resource planning and solution presentations for prospective Marketing Cloud Next migration engagements.


**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**
* Marketing Cloud Next — Platform Breadth: Strong functional knowledge of the full Marketing Cloud Next platform — Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Mobile Studio, Advertising Studio and Contact Builder. Able to architect solutions end\-to\-end and lead discovery without referring to technical resources for platform capability questions.
* Salesforce Data Cloud: Solid understanding of Data Cloud architecture — data streams, unified profiles, identity resolution, segmentation and activation to MCN — sufficient to own the functional integration design and validate the Data Cloud Architect's technical approach.
* Subscriber Data Model \& Consent Architecture: Deep understanding of MCN subscriber data model — data extensions, sendable/non\-sendable objects, contact counts, suppression lists — and proven expertise designing consent migration strategies that comply with GDPR, CAN\-SPAM, CASL and POPI.
* Legacy Marketing Platform Knowledge: Working knowledge of at least one major legacy marketing platform (Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, legacy SFMC Classic) — sufficient to run discovery workshops, assess migration complexity and translate legacy features to MCN equivalents.
* Journey \& Campaign Migration Strategy: Proven ability to inventory, assess and prioritise complex legacy marketing automation libraries — mapping legacy journey logic, drip campaigns and triggered send rules to Journey Builder native design patterns.
* Email Deliverability: Solid understanding of email deliverability principles — IP warm\-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, sender reputation, inbox placement — to advise clients on post\-migration deliverability strategy.
* Integration Architecture Awareness: Understanding of Marketing Cloud Connect (CRM sync), REST/SOAP MC APIs, API\-triggered sends and event\-driven messaging — sufficient to design functional integration specifications and validate the TA's implementation approach.
* Data Migration Strategy (Functional): Ability to define what data migrates, the business transformation rules governing subscriber and consent data, validation criteria for data sign\-off and the business cutover sequence — partnering with the TA and Data Cloud Architect for ETL execution.
* Salesforce Platform Awareness: Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM, Sales/Service Cloud data model, Flows and permission sets — sufficient to design end\-to\-end MCN solutions that integrate with the broader Salesforce org.
* Functional Design Documentation: Expertise in producing executive\-quality solution blueprints, functional design documents, process maps, data mapping specifications, migration approach papers and UAT test scripts.
* Workshop Facilitation \& Client Management: Proven ability to lead large, complex discovery workshops and design sessions with senior client stakeholders — managing scope discussions, capturing requirements and building consensus on migration approach.
* Agile Delivery: Proficiency in Agile delivery practices — user story writing, backlog management, sprint planning and sprint review facilitation — within the Migration Factory's MDLC wave delivery model.


**Preferred Skills — Good To Have**

* Knowledge of WhatsApp, Push, SMS and LINE channel migration alongside email

title: Sr. Staff Architect
description:
**About Gap Inc.**
 Our past is full of iconic moments — but our future is going to spark many more. Our brands — Gap, Banana Republic, Old Navy and Athleta — have dressed people from all walks of life and all kinds of families, all over the world, for every occasion for more than 50 years.
   

  

 But we’re more than the clothes that we make. We know that business can and should be a force for good, and it’s why we work hard to make product that makes people feel good, inside and out. It’s why we’re committed to giving back to the communities where we live and work. If you're one of the super\-talented who thrive on change, aren't afraid to take risks and love to make a difference, come grow with us.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior Staff Architect, you are a high\-impact individual contributor responsible for designing robust and scalable solutions within a domain stream. You bring deep technical and functional expertise and partner with cross\-functional teams to define and implement architecture that supports business and technical objectives. Department: Enterprise ArchitectureRole : Senior Staff Enterprise Solution ArchitectEmployment Type : Full\- TimeLocation: Hyderabad, India (HDC)This role is focused on hands\-on solution design, documentation, and delivery — with increasing influence across products, platforms, and governing teams. You bring deep expertise in retail and consumer goods, partnering with cross\-functional business, product, and engineering teams to define and implement architecture that is robust, scalable, and aligned to both business and technical objectives.You serve as a bridge between architecture and engineering leadership, ensuring consistency, quality, and performance of solutions. As AI reshapes how software is designed and delivered, you will play an active role in embedding AI\-driven thinking into architecture practices and championing adoption across your domain.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

**Solution design \& documentation**
* Design and document end\-to\-end solutions for key initiatives within your domain, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards and business needs.


**Project architecture leadership**
* Lead architecture for individual projects and features, guiding engineering teams through solution execution and well\-reasoned technical trade\-offs.


**Cross\-functional collaboration**
* Partner with strategy teams, product managers, architects and engineers to translate requirements into scalable, maintainable architecture complaining to EA guidelines. Provide architectural input across multiple simultaneous initiatives.


**Quality, feasibility \& integration alignment**
* Ensure technical feasibility, performance, and integration alignment of solutions with adjacent systems and domains. Participate in defining, enhancing and ensuring design and code reviews to uphold architectural quality.


**Architecture framework \& reusability**
* Contribute to the evolution of architecture frameworks, reusable components, and reference implementations that raise the bar across the engineering organisation.


**Planning, estimation \& technology evaluation**
* Engage in early project planning and estimation through an architecture lens. Stay current with emerging technologies and help evaluate their applicability within your domain.


**AI ADOPTION**
* Identify and drive opportunities to integrate AI and ML capabilities into enterprise domain solutions to enhance business value and operational efficiency.
* Serve as a strategic advocate for responsible, ethical, and compliant AI adoption across the domain architecture landscape.
* Lead the execution and advancement of enterprise architecture strategies in alignment with the vision and direction established by Principal Architects.


**ENTERPRISE ARCHITECTURE COLLABORATION**
* Hands\-on solution design and delivery within a domain stream. Operationalises enterprise guidance into project\-level architecture.


**Alignment With Principal \& Sr Principal Architects**
 Engage regularly with Principal and Senior Principal Architects to ensure domain\-level solutions are grounded in enterprise architecture strategy. Consume and operationalise enterprise standards, patterns, and guardrails into project\-level designs, and surface domain\-specific insights that inform broader strategic decisions.
   

  

**Cross\-domain Architecture Reviews**
 Participate in architecture review boards and cross\-domain design forums facilitated by Principal Architects. Represent your domain's perspective, highlight integration touch\-points, and collaborate on solutions that span multiple domain streams.
   

  

**Feedback Loop \& Pattern Sharing**
 Maintain a continuous feedback loop with the EA team — sharing reusable patterns, lessons learned, and implementation experiences from domain delivery that can be elevated into enterprise\-wide frameworks and reference architectures.
   

  

**Strategic Roadmap Contribution**
 Contribute domain\-level input to enterprise technology roadmaps and strategic initiatives led by Senior Principal Architects. Help bridge the gap between long\-term architectural vision and near\-term delivery realities within your domain.
   

  

**SaaS Vendor Product Evaluations**
 Collaborate with Principal Architects and product stakeholders to ensure recommended SaaS choices are grounded in both domain delivery needs and long\-term enterprise architecture direction.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

* Seasoned technologist with strong architectural thinking and a solid background in hands\-on software or platform engineering.
* Deep understanding of at least one architectural Product to Market domain stream, with the ability to contribute meaningfully to cross\-domain conversations.
* Able to manage and prioritise multiple concurrent initiatives, providing architectural support from planning through to delivery.
* Experienced engaging with senior architecture leadership — comfortable consuming enterprise strategy from Principal and Senior Principal Architects and translating it into grounded, deliverable domain solutions.
* Skilled at producing technical documentation and architecture artifacts that clearly communicate design intent to both Strategy, Business, Engineering and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborative and delivery\-oriented, with a track record of working closely with cross\-functional product and engineering teams.
* Strong attention to detail with a passion for quality, performance, and reusability; capable of independently solving architectural challenges and escalating when cross\-functional coordination is needed.
* SaaS Vendor Evaluations \- Translate SaaS market evaluations into well\-reasoned architectural recommendations with clear trade\-off analysis : Cost \& TCO over time, Scalability \& performance, Integration complexity, Vendor maturity \& stability, Enterprise standards alignment, PoC / reference validation
* Eager to learn, grow, and actively contribute in defining and adopting enterprise architectural practices and patterns across the organisation.
* Comfortable navigating the nuances of responsible AI adoption — including data privacy, model governance, and balancing innovation with risk.
* A trusted voice within the EA community — able to represent domain interests in broader architecture forums while remaining open to enterprise\-wide direction and standards.
* Curious about AI and its practical application in enterprise architecture — whether through predictive analytics, generative AI, ML\-powered features, or AI\-augmented engineering workflows.


 Benefits at Gap Inc.
   

  

* One of the most competitive paid time off plans in the industry
* Comprehensive health coverage for employees, same\-sex partners and their families
* Health and wellness program: free annual health check\-ups, fitness center and Employee Assistance Program
* Comprehensive benefits to support the journey of parenthood
* Retirement planning assistance
* See more of the benefits we offer.


 Gap Inc. is an equal\-opportunity employer and is committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. We are committed to recruiting, hiring, training and promoting qualified people of all backgrounds, and make all employment decisions without regard to any protected status. We have received numerous awards for our long\-held commitment to equality and will continue to foster a diverse and inclusive environment of belonging. In 2022, we were recognized by Forbes as one of the World's Best Employers and one of the Best Employers for Diversity.

title: Adobe AEM Architect
description:
What you will do
   

  

 Let's do this! Let's change the world. Play a vital role and be part of the web team, which provides end\-to\-end digital solutions and hosting for global websites enabling Amgen brands to engage with healthcare professionals (HCPs) and our patients. The team provides an innovative web technology platform hosted in the cloud and ensures compliances and security features across our websites. You will be part of Amgen's Global Commercial Client Facing Web Technology Team.
   

  

 As an Adobe AEM Architect (CMS Architect), you will serve as the technical authority for the Adobe Experience Manager platform. You will define the platform architecture, establish engineering standards and governance, and ensure the platform remains secure, scalable, reliable, and aligned with enterprise technology strategies. You will partner closely with product teams, developers, operations, infrastructure, security, and enterprise architecture to enable successful digital experiences across Amgen.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Own the overall operational health, stability, availability, and continuous improvement of Amgen's global Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) platform.
* Define and govern platform architecture, engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices to ensure consistency, scalability, security, and maintainability across global implementations.
* Lead day\-to\-day platform operations, including incident management, problem management, root cause analysis, service requests, and technical escalations for production issues.
* Oversee operational support activities, including ticket triage, platform maintenance, release readiness, upgrades, patching, and change management to ensure reliable platform operations.
* Design and implement reusable AEM components, platform services, integrations, and foundational capabilities that enable multiple product and delivery teams.
* Establish and optimize platform monitoring, observability, performance tuning, caching strategies, and operational metrics to proactively identify and resolve issues.

* Define and maintain CI/CD, deployment, and operational processes that support secure, efficient, and compliant software delivery.
* Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership for new platform capabilities, integrations, and modernization initiatives while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards.
* Mentor engineers and platform support team members on AEM architecture, operational excellence, troubleshooting methodologies, and engineering best practices.
* Drive automation initiatives that improve operational efficiency, reduce manual support activities, and enhance platform reliability and supportability.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product teams, and cross\-functional partners to prioritize platform enhancements, operational improvements, and strategic roadmap initiatives.


**Win**

 We are all different, yet we all use our outstanding contributions to serve patients. The enthusiastic professional we seek is a problem\-solver with these qualifications.
   

  

 Bachelor's degree and 8 to 13 years of Information Systems experience

 Thrive

 As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, so we work to care for our teammates' professional and personal growth and well\-being.

 Own scope, risks, dependencies, and issue management
   

  

 Help orchestrate agile ceremonies and sprint execution

 Upstream systems
   

  

 Downstream applications
   

  

 Data owners Business teams
   

  

 Countries

 Resolve blockers and ensure smooth sprint execution

 Translate business needs into scalable MDM solutions
   

  

 Support business case evolution and roadmap definition
   

  

 Provide technical mentorship to team members
   

  

 Communicate architecture decisions and trade\-offs clearly
   

  

 Drive adoption through structured communication and enablement
   

  

**About You**
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field
   

  

 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in Master Data Management with 3\+ years of Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS solution, with at least \+3 years managing teams and delivering successful MDM implementations
   

  

**Proven Experience With**
 Informatica IDMC Customer 360 SaaS / Multidomain MDM
   

  

 Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS)
   

  

 Informatica Reference 360 (strong plus)
   

  

 Strong experience integrating MDM with Snowflake/Databricks or enterprise DWH platforms
   

  

**Deep Understanding Of**
 Customer data models
   

  

 Match \& Merge strategies
   

  

 Data governance frameworks
   

  

 Data quality methodologies
   

  

 Experience in defining and implementing MDM solution architectures
   

  

 Strong knowledge of batch and API\-based integration patterns
   

  

 Experience with Power BI or equivalent reporting tools (plus)
   

  

 Experience leading agile delivery in complex, multi\-country environments
   

  

 Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills
   

  

 Certifications in Informatica MDM (Developer / Administrator) are a plus.
   

  

 Key Competencies
   

  

 Strategic thinker with hands\-on technical depth
   

  

 Strong ownership and accountability mindset
   

  

 Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
   

  

 Ability to balance governance rigor with business agility
   

  

 Strong communication skills across business and technical audiences
   

  

 Comfortable operating in complex, multi\-system environments

 What Success Looks Like

 On\-time and predictable delivery execution

title: Lead, Tech (GAITech)

We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced software developer to join the GAI Tech team at the D. E. Shaw India office based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. The GAI Tech team is responsible for building infrastructure and applications of Generative AI (GAI) within the firm. The team's objectives consist of identifying the most productive GAI models, providing tools for sophisticated GAI\-based applications, creating initial iterations of GAI tools, and offering support for technical staff involved with GAI projects.  The ideal candidate should hold\-

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Company Description**
 Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About us, but we'll be brief:**
 Experian is the world's leading global information services company, unlocking the power of data to create more opportunities for consumers, businesses and society. We are thrilled to share that FORTUNE has named Experian one of the 100 Best Companies to work for. In addition, for the last five years we've been listed as one of the 100 "World's Most Innovative Companies" by Forbes Magazine.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 You will be the architecture owner for Experian's telephony, Teams Calling, and Contact Center services. As we modernize, we are moving toward a cloud‑first, Teams‑centric model. In this model, NICE will serve as the contact center platform, and we will use Teams Calling for corporate/campus telephony. This role is accountable for the end‑to‑end technical design and standards. This includes global telephony transformation. We mean this transformation to replace EOL Avaya, reduce on\-premise dependencies. It will also deliver features such as advanced IVR, dashboards, reporting, AI/speech recognition, omnichannel, call recording, and call accounting, etc. Additionally, I designed and guided Experian's contact center capability uplift. This included Presence Bi‑Sync with Salesforce Omni‑Channel, advanced quality, sentiment analysis, self‑service/automation, and ACD enhancements. I measured all of these against efficiency targets and business benefits. APAC modernization and discovery work (e.g., Teams Calling \+ NICE CXone direction; addressing EOL Cisco/Ribbon, India calling enablement constraints, and staff augmentation needs). This role directly owns PSTN/calling architecture, carrier/SBC design, numbering/porting, call routing, contact center flows, recording/QA/analytics, and compliance\-aligned controls. You will report to a Senior Director.
   

  

**Summary Of Primary Responsibilities**
* Own global telephony \& contact center target architectures: Define and maintain end‑to‑end designs for Teams Calling, NICE contact center, call routing, numbering, porting, recording/CDR, and integration patterns across regions.
* The UKI \& EMEA telephony modernization architecture authority is responsible for leading the technical approach. This approach involves replacing legacy Avaya, including the decommission of \~60 Avaya devices, and delivering the proposed campus/contact center changes. These changes include desk phone removal as standard, power\-user and VIP retention models, mandatory CC training, and enhanced IVR/ACD/analytics/automation capabilities.
* Contact center evolution and feature enablement involve architecting and governing advanced CC capabilities. We plan or have in\-flight these capabilities. They include integrating Salesforce enhancements, implementing Presence Bi\-Sync, developing omnichannel, creating QM\+/quality, conducting sentiment analysis, and designing automation/self\-service patterns. Examples of automation/self\-service patterns are password reset self\-service IVR flows and Origins integration.
* Compliance, risk, and data\-flow architecture: Own the technical inputs required to satisfy multi‑region risk/compliance needs, including DPIA/LIA/ROPA/TPRA patterns, country data residency constraints, and risk items affecting schedule/solution design. Drive "secure by design" call recording and processing architectures.
* Carrier/SBC and routing design leadership involves leading carrier/provider architecture decisions. It also includes solution designs, considering constraints that require Teams and NICE migrations to occur together in certain routing models. Additionally, it requires finalizing EMEA routing designs.
* Operational reliability and ITSM guardrails: Define architecture standards for availability, survivability, monitoring, and change rigor while modernization executes—balancing "run" stability with transformation delivery.
* Executive\-ready architecture artifacts: Produce reference architecture, option papers, sequencing plans, and risk statements to support business cases, funding approvals, vendor due diligence, and leadership decision forums.


**Qualifications**
* 10–15\+ years developing enterprise telephony/voice and contact center solutions in several environments (global/multi‑region preferred).
* Demonstrated experience modernizing from legacy PBX/contact center platforms to cloud SaaS models with emphasis on routing/porting/numbering, agent workflows, and service continuity.
* You have Contact center domain depth (e.g., NICE\-like platforms) including call flows, IVR/ACD, recording, QA, analytics, and CRM integration patterns.
* You have good partner communication—able to translate architecture tradeoffs into clear decisions for all kinds of audiences.
* You have operational governance and discipline; comfortable operating in environments with active risk, compliance review cycles, and change controls.


**Additional Information**
 Our uniqueness is that we truly celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what truly matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, engagement, collaboration, wellness, reward \& recognition, volunteering... the list goes on. Experian's strong people first approach is award winning; Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries, FORTUNE Best Companies to work and Glassdoor Best Places to Work (globally 4\.4 Stars) to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site to understand why.
   

  

 Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Innovation is a critical part of Experian's DNA and practices, and our diverse workforce drives our success. Everyone can succeed at Experian and bring their whole self to work, irrespective of their gender, ethnicity, religion, color, sexuality, physical ability or age. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Experian care for employee's work life balance, health, safety and wellbeing. In support of this endeavor, we offer best\-in\-class family well\-being benefits, enhanced medical benefits and paid time off.

title: Vice President | Senior Engineer API Gateway
description:

 13

+ Code generation
+ Code refactoring
+ SQL optimization
+ PySpark optimization, etc.
