title: Manager, Cloud Engineering
description:
Manages technical support staff who provide technical support for the design and building of technical solutions. Provides leadership in designing, developing and implementing solutions in support of the business, according to standards and policies.
   

  

**About Vanguard**
 Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
   

  

**Vanguard India**
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 This role manages technical support staff who provide technical support for the design and building of technical solutions. Provides leadership in designing, developing and implementing solutions in support of the business, according to standards and policies, while mentoring junior staff and guiding technology decisions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Manager of Cloud Platform Engineering to lead a team responsible for designing, supporting, and evolving cloud\-based technology platforms. This role requires a unique blend of technical expertise, leadership skills, business judgment, and problem\-solving ability.
* The ideal candidate is a strong technical leader who can quickly recognize patterns, diagnose complex issues, navigate ambiguity, and make sound decisions that balance risk, operational stability, and business outcomes. While hands\-on coding is not a primary responsibility, the successful candidate must possess sufficient technical depth to guide engineering teams, evaluate solutions, and influence architectural decisions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of cloud engineers, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on cloud platform strategy, architecture, reliability, and operational excellence.
* Partner with engineering, infrastructure, security, architecture, and business teams to deliver scalable and resilient solutions.
* Facilitate technical decision\-making by evaluating trade\-offs, identifying risks, and aligning recommendations with organizational objectives.
* Apply strong pattern recognition and analytical thinking to identify root causes, recurring issues, operational trends, and optimization opportunities.
* Make informed judgment calls during incidents, escalations, and complex technical situations where complete information may not be available.
* Drive issue resolution across organizational boundaries and remove obstacles preventing team success.
* Establish operational best practices, governance processes, and performance metrics.
* Support workforce planning, performance management, career development, and succession planning activities.
* Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Manages the resolution of the most complex platform issues elevated from staff and clients.
* Manages technical support staff who implement, monitor, troubleshoot, and install cloud computing platforms across all systems. Plans, develops, and executes short\-range goals and strategies to meet department, divisional, and corporate objectives.
* Develops and implements changes to department policies and standard operating procedures to meet changing business needs. Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement. Leads quality initiatives to improve the delivery of service levels.
* Responsible for delivering software maintenance and ensuring optimization of system uptime and performance for critical technology is completed. Collaborates with key stakeholders to develop and maintain standards for platforms. Implements new technologies for enterprise\-wide infrastructure projects.
* Develops technical standards to serve Vanguard technical needs. Manages the ongoing performance of IT cloud vendor products and services.
* Learns and understands client area business functions and requirements. Determines the appropriate technical tool to address the client's business needs.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Maintain the security of cloud infrastructure, ensuring compliance with both internal business standards and relevant regulatory requirements.
* Oversee and monitor hybrid cloud environments, ensuring optimal performance, uptime, and resource allocation for the organization.
* Develop and implement automation scripts to streamline the deployment, management, and scaling of cloud\-based resources, improving operational efficiency.
* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for cloud architectures, designs, and system configurations to guide future development and operational support.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Minimum 8 years of experience in managing complex enterprise\-wide cloud infrastructure projects and environments.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Expertise in designing, implementing, and supporting cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) at scale.
* Strong understanding of cloud security principles, regulatory compliance, and risk mitigation.
* Working knowledge of Agile methodology, JIRA, and Confluence for project and incident tracking.
* Strong knowledge of AWS services and cloud operating models.
* Experience leading technical teams responsible for cloud infrastructure, platforms, or enterprise technology services.
* Exceptional problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills.
* Demonstrated ability to identify patterns, trends, and systemic issues across complex environments.
* Strong decision\-making skills with the ability to balance technical, operational, and business considerations.
* Experience managing priorities across multiple initiatives and stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and relationship\-building skills.
* Experience with enterprise cloud platforms, database technologies, data replication, automation, or infrastructure services.
* Familiarity with DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and cloud governance practices.
* AWS certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, AWS Cloud Practitioner, or AWS Certified SysOps Administrator.
* Experience leading teams through transformation, modernization, or cloud migration initiatives.


**Location**
 This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
   

  

**Our mission**
 Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
   

  

**Our commitment to you**
 Vanguard takes the same long\-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
   

  

**Financial wellness**
 We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
   

  

**Physical wellness**
 We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
   

  

**Personal wellness**
 We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
   

  

**How We Work**
 Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in\-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission\-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long\-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: Senior Technical Lead (Product Releases & Engineering)
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**
 Company Name: Incepteo
   

  

 Industry: Information Technology \& Services
   

  

 Seniority level: Mid\-Senior level
   

  

 Experience: 5\+ yrs
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
   

  

 Job Type: Full\-time
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
   

  

 Senior Technical Lead – Product Releases \& Engineering
   

  

 Role Purpose
   

  

 We are looking for a mature, hands\-on Senior Technical Lead who can bring structure, predictability and ownership to the engineering and release process for Stratpilot.
   

  

 The role sits between the Product Owner, Delivery Manager, Technical Architect and engineering team. Your primary responsibility is to ensure that multiple developers, features and code changes come together into stable, well\-coordinated product releases.
   

  

 This is not simply a senior developer role and it is not a purely managerial position. You must remain technically hands\-on while taking ownership of release coordination, engineering discipline and day\-to\-day technical delivery.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Release Management
   

  

 You will coordinate releases across Development → Test / QA → UAT → Production → Monitoring.
   

  

  

* Coordinate release scope with the Product Owner and Delivery Manager, maintaining visibility of features, fixes and dependencies
* Ensure development, code reviews, integration and testing are completed before release and conduct technical release\-readiness checks
* Coordinate application, API, database and configuration changes; manage release branches, versioning, hotfixes and production fixes
* Coordinate deployments across Dev, Test, UAT and Production, support UAT issue resolution and provide technical Go / No\-Go recommendations
* Ensure rollback or recovery procedures are understood, validate Production releases and coordinate post\-release issue resolution


 The objective is to create a repeatable, controlled and increasingly automated release process rather than relying on individual developers or last\-minute effort.
   

  

 Engineering Team Coordination
   

  

  

* Maintain visibility of development progress and identify dependencies across frontend, backend, database and integrations
* Ensure developers understand requirements and technical expectations; identify blockers and risks early
* Coordinate work where features cross multiple components, help resolve difficult technical issues and review progress against sprint and release commitments
* Escalate architectural concerns to the Technical Architect, delivery risks to the Delivery Manager, and work with the Product Owner where requirements need clarification


 The successful candidate should bring structure without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
   

  

 Engineering Maturity \& Quality
   

  

 You will help strengthen:
   

  

  

* Pull\-request and code\-review discipline; Git branching, merge management, release branching and versioning
* Definition of Done, release\-readiness criteria, automated build/test/deployment, code coverage and automated testing
* Environment management, logging and monitoring, technical documentation, incident management and root\-cause analysis
* Technical\-debt management and secure development practices


 You will ensure code produced by different developers is properly reviewed, consolidated and integrated before entering shared environments.
   

  

 Hands\-On Technical Capability
   

  

 Although release and team coordination are the main focus, this remains a hands\-on technical leadership role. You should be comfortable working across React / React.js, Python, REST APIs and backend services, MySQL or similar relational databases, Git and GitHub, GitHub Actions / CI/CD, Google Cloud Platform, authentication and authorisation, SaaS integrations, logging, monitoring and production troubleshooting.
   

  

 Strong, practical experience with Google Cloud Platform and GitHub is vital for this role. You should have hands\-on experience using Google Cloud services to deploy, operate, monitor and troubleshoot production SaaS applications, and be confident managing GitHub repositories, pull requests, branching strategies, code reviews, permissions and GitHub Actions\-based CI/CD workflows.
   

  

 You should be capable of reviewing code, challenging implementation decisions and stepping into complex technical or production issues when necessary.
   

  

 Experience with AI applications, LLMs, agents, RAG, MCP, LangGraph/LangChain, OpenAI, Claude or Gemini would be advantageous.
   

  

 Production \& Incident Management
   

  

  

* Assess incident severity and impact, coordinate developers during investigation and identify root causes
* Manage hotfixes and emergency releases, communicate technical status clearly and validate systems following fixes
* Conduct root\-cause reviews and ensure preventative actions are completed


 We are looking for someone who remains calm, methodical and accountable under pressure.
   

  

 Experience We Are Looking For
   

  

 Ideally, you will have 5\+ years of software engineering experience with meaningful technical leadership responsibility in a production SaaS environment, including:
   

  

  

* Coordinating development teams and managing SaaS releases into Production across Dev, Test, UAT and Production environments
* Google Cloud deployment, operations, monitoring and troubleshooting
* GitHub repository, branch, pull\-request and permissions management, including GitHub Actions and CI/CD automation
* Release\-readiness, deployment processes, code consolidation and strong code\-review practices
* Production incident resolution, cross\-functional working with Product Owners, architects and delivery managers, and continuous engineering process improvement


 We are particularly interested in candidates who have personally owned these responsibilities, rather than simply participated within a team where others managed releases and coordination.
   

  

 Leadership Maturity
   

  

  

* Ownership – takes responsibility and drives outcomes
* Judgement – knows when to proceed, challenge or escalate
* Organisation – keeps multiple developers and dependencies coordinated
* Communication – explains technical issues clearly
* Composure – remains effective during releases and incidents
* Constructive leadership – guides developers without micromanaging
* Quality mindset – balances speed with reliability
* Continuous improvement – strengthens processes after every release


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

  

* More predictable and controlled releases with clear ownership and readiness criteria
* Better engineering coordination with earlier visibility of blockers and dependencies
* Stronger GitHub, PR, code\-review, testing and CI/CD discipline and more reliable Google Cloud operations
* Fewer release\-related defects and last\-minute integration issues, with faster Production incident resolution
* Improved engineering maturity and reduced dependency on individual heroics


**In one sentence: Your responsibility is to turn multiple developers, features and code changes into one coordinated engineering team delivering stable, high\-quality SaaS releases consistently for the Stratpilot venture, using strong GitHub practices and reliable Google Cloud delivery and operations.**
**About The Company**
 About Incepteo Labs Incepteo Labs Private Limited is a dynamic and fast\-growing startup venture builder creating innovative technology products and businesses. This role offers the opportunity to work in a high\-energy environment where ideas move quickly from concept to execution and where engineer
   

  

 Good\-to\-have skills
   

  

 Release Management

title: Cloud AI Security - Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
 Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever\-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Manager \- Cloud AI Security
   

  

 Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.
   

  

**Work you’ll do**
 As a Cloud AI Security Manager, you will lead client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will help clients define and implement secure AI strategies, architectures, governance models, and control frameworks across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining. You will be expected to lead engagement delivery, manage senior client stakeholders, guide cross\-functional teams, mentor junior practitioners, and drive high\-quality outcomes across AI security, cloud security, governance, compliance, and risk management.
   

  

 Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:
   

  

* Lead client engagements focused on AI, GenAI, and ML security across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud environments.
* Lead the design and implementation of AI security solutions aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Oversee AI security assessments for cloud\-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001\.
* Lead threat modeling, architecture reviews, and control design for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector use.
* Define secure AI reference architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external integrations.
* Guide secure deployment and configuration of cloud\-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Oversee implementation of platform\-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption, key management, secrets management, access restrictions, tenant isolation, content safety controls, and service\-native logging and monitoring.
* Lead DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration by embedding security checks, policy validation, secrets handling, model governance, and compliance controls into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Establish secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, training, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining.
* Lead AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, control mapping, audit readiness, and policy alignment.
* Drive AI security posture management using cloud\-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related capabilities to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous activity, and policy violations.
* Oversee AI\-specific monitoring and incident response capabilities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent misuse, unauthorized model access, data leakage, and control failures.
* Lead or coordinate AI security testing activities including misuse\-case testing, prompt attack validation, model guardrail reviews, red\-team support, and remediation planning.
* Manage client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, architecture, data, ML engineering, privacy, legal, and risk teams.
* Lead teams of analysts, consultants, and senior consultants by assigning work, reviewing outputs, coaching team members, and ensuring quality of delivery.
* Contribute to business development, proposals, solutioning, thought leadership, reusable assets, and practice development initiatives related to cloud AI security.


**The team**
 Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.
   

  

**Required:**
* 9\+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, AI security, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading client\-facing engagements or major workstreams in security, cloud, or AI\-related programs.
* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud\-hosted applications, platforms, and AI/ML environments.
* Strong experience with one or more major cloud platforms, with working knowledge across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, model governance, and responsible AI controls.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.
* Familiarity with governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and related control frameworks.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating technical and risk matters to executive and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading teams, mentoring junior practitioners, and managing quality across client deliverables.


**Preferred:**
* Experience leading AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, remediation programs, or transformation initiatives across one or more major cloud platforms.
* Deep hands\-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud\-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, AI runtime monitoring, and agent security for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse\-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM\-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API\-driven, and agent\-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, documentation standards, and audit support.
* Experience contributing to proposals, solution development, go\-to\-market offerings, and practice\-building activities.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, Microsoft Azure security certifications, or comparable senior\-level cloud and security credentials.


**How You’ll Grow**
 At Deloitte, our professional development plan focuses on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer opportunities to help sharpen skills in addition to hands\-on experience in the global, fast\-changing business world. From on\-the\-job learning experiences to formal development programs at Deloitte University, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career. Explore Deloitte University, The Leadership Center.
   

  

**Benefits**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Team Leadership \& People Management
   

  

* Manage a team of Network Development Engineers (NDEs) focused on capacity restoration tooling, automation, and network engineering solutions
* Hire, develop, coach, and promote engineers; build a high\-performing team that delivers successfully and sustainably
* Strategically assign projects to grow engineer skillsets toward next\-level demonstration
* Drive a culture of operational excellence, data\-driven decision\-making, and continuous improvement
* Establish and maintain a sustainable on\-call rotation that honors SLAs without burning out engineers


 Strategic Direction \& Execution
   

  

* Define the vision, tenets, and strategic roadmap for the team and align with wider organizational goals
* Own a line\-up of capacity restoration products.
* Represent the team autonomously to senior leadership; drive long\-term strategic direction with limited guidance
* Write effective narratives (PR/FAQ, six\-pager) for senior leaders; provide input to OP1/OP2 planning
* Proactively identify architectural gaps and drive resolution of deficiencies in capacity restoration systems


 Technical Ownership
   

  

* Drive engineering efforts to solve complex backbone/border network capacity problems at the architectural level
* Understand system limitations, scaling factors, and reasons behind architectural decisions; question proposals and test assumptions
* Make trade\-offs between short\-term team needs and long\-term business/architecture needs, inclusive of cost
* Drive simplification and optimization of capacity restoration processes and tooling
* Decouple dependencies between fabrics and prevent duplicative engineering efforts across teams
* Ensure development is focused on the right solutions with mindfulness of long\-term architecture consequences


 Operational Excellence
   

  

* Define audit mechanisms and metrics that explain team performance and variance against goals
* Manage deferred maintenance across all systems; allocate engineering time to reduce technical debt
* Hold postmortems and drive root\-cause resolution; document lessons learned in COEs
* Ensure team compliance with Amazon security, data handling, and operational policies
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with backbone operations, border engineering, and controller teams


 Scope and Impact
   

  

* Own the development of one or more capacity restoration products spanning backbone and border network fabrics
* Network products may have external or multi\-org impact; trusted with organizational goals
* Influence strategic direction of the team and may influence other team roadmaps
* Work spans organizations and geographies in support of network availability, scalability, cost, and performance


**About The Team**
 The Capacity Restoration Team (CRT) is responsible for restoring backbone and border network capacity impacted by failures, maintenance events, and service disruptions across Amazon's global network infrastructure. As the Network Development Manager for CRT, you will own the development and evolution of network capacity restoration solutions, automation tooling, and operational frameworks that ensure rapid, data\-driven recovery of backbone/border network capacity.
   

  

 You will own the strategic direction of capacity restoration, driving innovation in how Amazon identifies, prioritizes, and resolves capacity impairments. Your team's work directly impacts network availability, scalability, and cost\-efficiency across Amazon's backbone and border fabric.
   

  

**About Aws**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and Amaze Con (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

* Experience in managing teams
* Experience in engineering
* Experience in a technology role

**Preferred Qualifications**

description:
**Position: Senior Technical Architect Scalable Multi\-Tenant Systems**
**Location: Hyderabad ( 8 PM to 5 AM IST)**
**Work Type: Full\-Time**
**Experience: 10\+ Years**
**PETADATA is looking for a skilled Senior Technical Architect to own the architecture of a scalable, secure, multi\-tenant SaaS platform. The role will drive system design, distributed systems, data architecture, cloud infrastructure, security, and integrations while setting technical standards across engineering. The ideal candidate is a principal\-level architect with proven experience scaling production SaaS systems and strong technical leadership skills.**
**Key Responsibilities** 
**Multi\-Tenant Architecture**
* Design the platform's multi\-tenancy model, including tenant isolation, data partitioning, per\-tenant configuration, and noisy\-neighbor mitigation.
* Architect reliable tenant provisioning, onboarding, scaling, and decommissioning.
* Ensure tenant data isolation and security across all system layers.


**Scalability \& Distributed Systems**
* Design systems capable of handling large data volumes and concurrent migration workloads.
* Architect async/event\-driven processing, queues, horizontal scaling, backpressure, retries, and idempotency.
* Define the overall data architecture, including storage, partitioning, streaming, batch processing, and data pipelines.
* Select appropriate architectural patterns while avoiding unnecessary complexity and over\-engineering.


**Reliability \& Security**
* Establish high availability, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and SLA strategies.
* Build security and compliance into the architecture, including encryption, access control, secrets management, auditing, and tenant isolation.
* Define the observability strategy for monitoring, tracing, and troubleshooting distributed systems.


**Integration \& Platform Architecture**
* Architect a scalable connector and integration framework supporting systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, databases, and object stores.
* Design scalable APIs and platform abstractions that support multiple use cases without repeated architectural redesign.
* Partner with DevOps/Infrastructure teams on cloud and multi\-cloud architecture across AWS, GCP, and Azure.


**Technical Leadership**
* Establish architectural standards, design patterns, and technical roadmaps.
* Make key build\-vs\-buy and technology decisions.
* Lead architecture and design reviews and mentor senior engineers.
* Translate business and product requirements into a clear technical strategy and execution plan.
* Influence engineering teams through technical judgment, expertise, and results.


**Note: Should be able to work independently and work in USA time zones**
**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, with several years in an Architect, Principal, or Staff\+ role owning system architecture at scale.
* Proven hands\-on experience designing and scaling multi\-tenant SaaS systems in production, including tenant isolation, partitioning, and scaling strategies.
* Deep expertise in distributed systems, including event\-driven processing, queues, horizontal scaling, consistency, fault tolerance, and high\-throughput workloads.
* Strong data architecture experience covering data modeling, partitioning, batch/streaming pipelines, and data\-intensive systems.
* Strong cloud\-native architecture expertise with AWS, GCP, or Azure and the ability to reason across cloud providers.
* Strong understanding of security, compliance, tenant isolation, encryption, access control, and frameworks such as SOC 2/GDPR.
* Strong software engineering and coding skills, with the ability to prototype and work directly with complex parts of the codebase.
* Proven technical leadership and influence, with experience setting architecture direction and earning trust across engineering teams.
* Experience with data migration, ETL/integration, iPaaS, or large\-scale connector frameworks is preferred.
* Experience with CRM platforms and APIs, particularly Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zoho, is a plus.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, containers, Terraform/IaC, and modern CI/CD.
* Experience working with high\-compliance or regulated\-data environments is a plus.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, communication, and architectural judgment skills.
* Highly self\-directed and pragmatic, with the ability to balance long\-term architecture with rapid product delivery.
* Experience as a founding architect or early senior technical leader is a plus.


**Education**
**Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.**
**Candidates must attend Phone/video calls and in\-person interviews. After selection, candidates will undergo background checks on Education and Experience.**
**Please email your resume to varshitham@petadata.ai**
**After carefully reviewing your experience and skills, one of our HR team members will contact you about the next steps.**

title: Principal Architect-UI Platforms
description:
****Overview****
 Architect, UI Platforms, Windows Platform \& Developer (WPD) Organization
   

  

**Overview**
 Would you like to help shape the UI platform that powers Windows experiences used by millions of developers and customers every day? The Windows Platform \& Developer (WPD) Organization team builds and evolves the UI frameworks and APIs that first and thirdparty developers rely on to create highquality desktop and enterprise line\-of\-business (LOB) applications.
   

  

 We are looking for a UI Platform Architect to help guide the next phase of Windows UI Platform’s evolution (including WinUI3\) —modernizing the platform, improving fundamentals such as performance and reliability, and ensuring the developer experience meets the expectations of today’s desktop and enterprise app builders. This role blends strategic thinking with handson technical leadership and offers the opportunity to influence a widely used platform while staying close to real developer scenarios.
   

  

 As a UI Platform Architect, you will also focus on evolving WinUI into a modern, AI‑native UI framework that remains competitive with SwiftUI while embracing a future where agents author a significant portion of application code. This requires rethinking WinUI as a declarative, composable, and semantically rich platform—one that is easy for web and SwiftUI developers to adopt, straightforward for AI agents to reason about, and powerful enough to enable dynamic, personalized user experiences at scale.
   

  

**As an UI Platform Architect,you will focus on**
* AI‑first developer experience: Design WinUI to be natively consumable by AI agents, with clear semantic models, stable abstractions, and predictable composition patterns that allow agents to author, refactor, and optimize UI code at scale.
* Seamless migration and adoption: Use AI‑assisted tooling and compatibility layers to enable low‑friction migration from legacy Windows UI stacks and SwiftUI on macOS, making WinUI a competitive and approachable choice for modern app developers.
* Declarative, dynamic UI foundation: Evolve WinUI into a truly declarative, state‑driven framework that supports real‑time personalization, adaptive layouts, and agent‑driven UI mutation without sacrificing performance or reliability.
* Lowering the barrier for web and SwiftUI developers: Provide opinionated projections, simplified APIs, and familiar programming models that align with modern web and SwiftUI mental models, accelerating time‑to‑productivity on Windows.
* Future‑proofing for AI‑generated code: Architect WinUI so that a majority of UI code can be safely generated and maintained by AI agents—emphasizing composability, guardrails, testability, and runtime validation.


****Responsibilities****
 As a Windows UI Platform Principal Architect, you will provide technical leadership across the Windows UI platform and work closely with engineering, program management, and partner teams.
   

  

**Platform architecture and technical leadership**
* Define and evolve the architectural direction for WinUI and related Windows UI components, ensuring designs are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with long‑term platform goals.
* Review and guide architecture and design proposals across multiple teams, helping ensure consistency and technical quality.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor and sounding board for senior engineers and leaders working across UI, shell, graphics, input, and app model areas.


**Modernization and quality of fundamentals**
* Drive improvements in core platform fundamentals that matter to real desktop and LOB apps, including startup performance, memory usage, responsiveness, reliability, accessibility, and theming.
* Help identify and address common friction points that developers encounter when building or modernizing Windows desktop applications.


****Developer Experience And Adoption****
* Influence API design patterns, lifecycle models, diagnostics, and tooling to make the platform easier and more predictable to build on.
* Partner with PM and engineering teams to improve guidance and reduce friction for teams adopting newer UI technologies.
* Engage constructively with the developer community (including open‑source communities where appropriate) to incorporate feedback and improve trust in the platform.


**Mentorship and architecture culture**
* Mentor senior ICs and aspiring architects, raising the overall bar for technical decision‑making and design quality.
* Promote clear written specs, design reviews, and thoughtful technical storytelling across the organization.


**Frontier mindset and AI\-powered productivity**
* Demonstrate a frontier\-firm mindset: stay ahead of emerging UI platform trends (including AI\-native UX patterns), challenge assumptions, and prototype quickly to de\-risk big bets.
* Use modern AI tools responsibly to increase personal and team efficiency (e.g., drafting specs, summarizing design discussions, generating test ideas, exploring API surface options), while maintaining high standards for correctness, security, and privacy.
* Create reusable accelerators (prompts, templates, automation, reference implementations) that help teams move faster without sacrificing quality, reliability, accessibility, or maintainability.
* Model a culture of learning and iteration: share best practices, run lightweight demos, and help the organization adopt effective AI\-assisted workflows.


****Qualifications****
**Required/Minimum Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#
+ OR equivalent experience.

* Significant hands‑on experience building desktop or rich‑client applications, with a strong focus on UX quality and system fundamentals.
* Depth in one or more UI frameworks for desktop or cross‑platform development, such as WinForms, WPF, WinUI, SwiftUI, UIKit/AppKit, .NET MAUI, Avalonia UI, Qt, Uno Platform, Flutter, or Electron in strongly desired.
* Proficiency in C\+\+ and/or C\# (or comparable systems languages), with the ability to reason across framework, runtime, and OS layers.
* Experience navigating UI architecture tradeoffs involving performance, memory, rendering, input, threading, accessibility, and app lifecycle.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction beyond your immediate team through design reviews, architectural guidance, or technical leadership.


**Other Requirements:**

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

title: Senior Manager, App Dev & Support
description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission\-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments \- creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Senior Technical Architect (Application Modernization)**
 We are seeking a visionary Technical Architect with a deep background in Application Modernization to lead a critical digital transformation. This role is focused on deconstructing a legacy 2\-tier architecture and rebuilding it into a scalable, high\-performance N\-tier system.
   

  

 You will be the bridge between the past and the future—moving our logic out of SQL stored procedures and migrating our legacy C\# frontend into a modern, responsive React/Redux ecosystem.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Architectural Strategy: Define the roadmap for migrating a monolithic 2\-tier application (Client/Server) to a decoupled, N\-tier architecture.
* Legacy Deconstruction: Analyze legacy C\# codebases and complex SQL stored procedures to identify business logic for extraction.
* Modernization Execution: Lead the shift of business logic from the database layer into a dedicated C\#/.NET Business Logic Layer (BLL) or Microservices.
* Frontend Leadership: Direct the transition from legacy UI to a modern React.js frontend, utilizing Redux for robust state management using Vite, Material UI, Redux Toolkit, React Query, React Hook Form, and Styled Components/SCSS.
* Ensure cross\-browser compatibility, visual consistency, and WCAG accessibility compliance.
* API Design: Architect and implement secure, RESTful APIs that serve as the communication backbone between the new frontend and the re\-engineered backend.
* Technical Governance: Establish coding standards, design patterns (e.g., Repository, Unit of Work), and CI/CD pipelines tailored for modernization projects.


**Technical Requirements**
 Category Requirements Modernization Proven experience moving logic from Stored Procedures to Application Code (Refactoring the "Smart Database" anti\-pattern). Frontend Expert\-level proficiency in React.js, Redux / Redux Toolkit, Vite, Material UI, React Query, React Hook Form, and Styled Components/SCSS and modern CSS frameworks (Bootstrap). Backend Strong mastery of C\# and .NET (6/7/8/9\+), specifically in building Web APIs and Service Layers (must have strong hands\-on experience in RestSharp, Dapper, Fluent Validations etc.). Database Deep understanding of SQL Server; ability to read/debug complex legacy T\-SQL and optimize new schemas. Architecture Solid grasp of N\-tier architecture, Dependency Injection, and Microservices patterns. Cloud/Containerization Expert\-level proficiency in Cloud (Azure), Docker and Kubernetes. Cache Mechanism Strong mastery in Redis for Cache Management
   

  

**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Modernization Veteran: 15\+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5\+ years specifically leading Legacy\-to\-Modern migration projects.
* The "2\-to\-N" Specialist: Demonstrated success in breaking down 2\-tier "Fat Client" or "Fat DB" systems into modular N\-tier environments.
* Strategic Thinker: Ability to balance "perfect" architecture with business continuity.
* Communication: Ability to explain technical debt and architectural ROI to stakeholders who may only see the UI changes.
* Industry certifications would definitely be considered.

title: Principal Software Architect
description:
**Opentext \- The Information Company**
 OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
   

  

**AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.**
 At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 Sets data and applied AI architecture direction for OpenText, working across product lines rather than within a single team. Defines how OpenText builds and governs data platforms (warehousing, lakehouses, graphs, vector stores) and the applied AI systems built on top of them. Acts as a technical authority that other architects and engineering teams consult on data and applied AI decisions.
   

  

**What The Role Offers**
* Design and review data architectures (warehouses, lakehouses, data platforms, graph and vector stores) that support analytics and AI workloads, including data quality, lineage, and governance (e.g., using layered patterns such as medallion/bronze\-silver\-gold where applicable).
* Evaluate and recommend data contract and product standards (e.g., ODCS, ODPS) for cross\-product adoption.
* Define reference architectures and patterns for applied AI systems (RAG, agentic AI, LLM integration) that other product teams can adopt, including governance considerations such as safety filtering, bias assessment, human\-in\-the\-loop mechanisms, and audit evidence requirements for autonomous/agentic systems.
* Advise on agentic AI architecture, including interoperability protocols such as MCP and A2A as well as emerging standards such as OpenID AuthZEN and OIDC\-A.
* Partner with product architects across OpenText to align data and AI architecture decisions with company\-wide standards. 6\.Represent data engineering and applied AI perspectives in architecture review boards and standards discussions. 7\.Communicate architectural trade\-offs to executive and non\-technical stakeholders, influencing direction across product lines without formal authority.
* Mentor other architects informally on data engineering and applied AI practices, without formal people\-management responsibility.


**What You Need To Succeed**
 1\.10\+ years in software architecture, data engineering, or AI/ML systems, or equivalent demonstrated depth.
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience.
* Track record operating as a software architect across multiple teams or products, not just within a single team.
* Demonstrated design of production data architectures at scale (e.g., data warehouse, lakehouse, or data platform), using layered patterns such as medallion/bronze\-silver\-gold where applicable.
* Hands\-on experience architecting applied AI systems (e.g., RAG pipelines, LLM\-integrated services) that have shipped to production.
* Experience building cloud\-native applications on a major hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containerized applications deployed on Kubernetes.


**One last thing**
 Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
   

  

 Prior cross\-product or cross\-org architecture role at a similarly sized enterprise software company.
   

  

 Breadth across data warehousing, lakehouses, data platforms, graphs, and vector technologies, valued over deep specialization in a single area.
   

  

 Familiarity with data contract/product standards such as ODCS (Open Data Contract Standard) or ODPS (Open Data Product Specification).
   

  

 Familiarity with data catalog and metadata management tools (e.g., Unity Catalog, Google Cloud Dataplex Universal Catalog, Apache Atlas, or equivalent).
   

  

 Experience with graph databases and building knowledge graphs.
   

  

 Experience with vector database technologies and embedding pipelines in production RAG systems (e.g., pgvector, Milvus, or equivalent).
   

  

 Experience designing streaming data architectures (e.g., Kafka, Flink, Delta Live Tables, or equivalent) alongside batch/medallion patterns.
   

  

 Experience with agentic AI architecture and interoperability protocols (MCP, A2A) or similar emerging standards.
   

  

 Familiarity with agentic AI safety patterns, including prompt injection defenses, guardrail design, and PII handling in agentic contexts.
   

  

 OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.

title: Senior CAD Engineer
description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing — an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
   

  

 We are now looking for a Physical Design Methodology and Operations Engineer! You'll join a small team that owns the infrastructure powering NVIDIA's semiconductor design flows — coordinating hundreds of thousands of jobs per day across datacenters with 10,000\+ hosts, serving over 1,000 chip designers worldwide. Our platform spans job orchestration, event\-driven trigger systems, global service interconnection, web interfaces to tools, and a Jenkins\-like CI/CD backbone — a production system with direct stakes in GPU, CPU, SoC and networking tapeouts. You'll own a functional area within the team while contributing across broader operations. Our stack includes mature Perl and Python services alongside modern React frontends and Elasticsearch\-based telemetry. We're actively modernizing, and we need someone who can think architecturally — evaluating what we have, identifying what needs to change, and driving that evolution in a way the team can execute and maintain. If you want to own something critical at scale and shape how it grows, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Designing and supporting mechanisms for coordinating and maintaining large\-scale semiconductor design tasks across multiple global datacenters.
* Owning the architecture of one or more platform components — defining interfaces, data models, and service boundaries that can scale and evolve.
* Leading the modernization of legacy services — evaluating existing Perl and Python backends, proposing migration strategies, and driving execution with the team.
* Debugging and improving production services spanning web browsers, containerized microservices, and bare\-metal Linux hosts.
* Building and improving web interfaces to configure, launch, and analyze EDA tools and design flows.
* Mining and analyzing large datasets of job execution telemetry and tool quality\-of\-results data to improve flows and catch regressions.
* Mentoring junior engineers and contributing to design reviews and technical standards across the team.

Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
 



  





**Job Overview** 




  





 Arcesium is building a Corporate AI Transformation team, and you will be one of its few first members. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work closely with business, operations and engineering teams to identify high\-impact internal use cases and convert them into working AI solutions that run in production.
 



 This is not a traditional backend or application engineering role. You will operate like a builder, systems engineer, and product thinker rolled into one. You will take ambiguous business problems, break them into solvable workflows, design the agent architecture, and ship production\-grade internal tools. You will work with Arcesium's corporate systems, data assets, and AI tech stack to build agents and automations that reduce manual effort, improve decision\-making, and scale repeatable work. Success for this role isn’t just measured by shipping a prototype or completing a project, it’s measured by putting solutions into production and driving meaningful adoption and impact.
 



 The ideal candidate brings strong engineering fundamentals, a builder’s mindset, and a passion for using AI to improve how work gets done. This is a high\-impact role for someone who wants to build AI solutions that meaningfully improve enterprise processes.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Partner with business and functional teams to find the opportunities: workflow automation, AI\-assisted decision\-making, and work that agents can take on.
* Understand complex operational processes across teams and convert them into structured problem statements, system designs, and technical workflows.
* Build agents, workflow automations, and internal applications on top of Arcesium's corporate data systems, and enterprise tools.
* Rapidly prototype using LLMs, agent frameworks, MCPs. Get something small in front of real users early and iterate on their feedback.
* Design agent architectures that complete business tasks reliably.
* Work with engineering, business, and security teams to take prototypes to move prototypes into scalable, maintainable solutions.
* Evaluate build\-vs\-buy options for AI workflows and identify the right technical approach for each use case.
* Create reusable components, templates and playbooks that accelerate this work across the firm.
* Define the KPIs, measure the impact, and drive adoption.



**What you'll need** 



* 6\+ years of hands\-on engineering experience, with a track record of shipping systems that other people depend on.
* Strong engineering fundamentals across APIs, data, and systems design.
* Experience building internal tools or automation systems for business teams.
* The ability to understand a platform quickly, build on top of it, and turn business context into reliable technical solutions.
* Systems thinking. You can hold a whole workflow in your head, see where it is structurally inefficient, and redesign it rather than automate it as it stands.
* A bias to ship iteratively. You get a thin version into real use, learn from it, and improve it, instead of waiting for a complete design.
* Credibility with senior business and technology leaders, and the ability to say hard things clearly to both.
* Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. You will pick your own problems as often as you are handed them.

description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
   

  

 You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
   

  

 As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 In this role, your technical depth, business aptitude, and ability to steer technology discussions at all levels will enable you to shape the customer journey. Your thought leadership, ability to look beyond the technology, and more holistically at the value technology creates for our customers, is crucial to your success.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers, AWS and partners, and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. You will go beyond the technical solution architecture, work with partners, sellers and specialists to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology.
   

  

**About The Team**
 This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India, working with the customers to help drive AWS services adoption.
   

  

**About AWS**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

**Description**
 About the Role
   

  

 The AI Technical Architect operates at the intersection of strategy and execution — acting as both a
 **Strategist** 
 , shaping the long\-term technical vision for AI adoption, and an
 **Orchestrator** 
 , coordinating people, systems, and processes to turn that vision into working solutions. This role is central to designing, scaling, and governing AI and Agentforce\-driven architectures across the delivery organization, ensuring technical decisions align with business outcomes and customer value.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Strategist Mindset**
* Define and evolve the technical architecture strategy for AI initiatives, aligning with broader business and platform roadmaps.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies (LLMs, agentic frameworks, automation platforms) and recommend where they create differentiated value.
* Partner with delivery, product, and engineering leadership to translate business goals into scalable, secure, and maintainable AI architectures.
* Establish architectural standards, patterns, and best practices for AI solution design across teams.
* Assess technical risk, feasibility, and total cost of ownership for proposed AI initiatives.


**Orchestrator Mindset**
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams (engineering, data, product, delivery) to ensure AI solutions are designed, built, and deployed cohesively.
* Serve as the technical glue between strategy and execution — ensuring architecture decisions are implemented consistently across squads and projects.
* Facilitate technical governance forums, architecture reviews, and design decision checkpoints.
* Drive alignment between multiple parallel AI workstreams, resolving dependencies and technical conflicts.
* Mentor and enable technical teams and solution architects on AI\-first design principles.


 Delivery \& Governance
   

  

 Builder Mindset
   

  

* Ship working AI solutions hands\-on — prototype, build, and iterate quickly rather than only designing on paper.
* Take ideas from concept to production, personally building agents, automations, and integrations when needed to prove value fast.
* Champion a bias for action: favor working demos and MVPs over long design documents.
* Continuously experiment with new AI tools and techniques, bringing working proofs\-of\-concept back to the team.
* Balance speed of shipping with architectural soundness, ensuring builds are scalable beyond the prototype stage.
* Own end\-to\-end technical quality of AI solutions from design through production readiness.
* Define and monitor architecture health metrics (scalability, reliability, cost\-efficiency, security posture).
* Ensure compliance with data governance, responsible AI, and security standards across all AI implementations.
* Provide technical escalation support for complex AI/architecture issues across the portfolio.


**Required Qualifications**

* Strong grasp of cloud\-native architecture, integration patterns, and platform scalability principles.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as both a strategic thinker and hands\-on technical orchestrator across multiple teams.

title: Solution Architect
description:
**About Chubb** 




  





 Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S\&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. * **Cloud \& Infrastructure Strategy**
* Drive Chubb’s cloud transformation agenda across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments. Define cloud landing zone patterns, establish FinOps guardrails, and set infrastructure\-as\-code standards using technologies such as Terraform and Kubernetes.

* Architect event\-driven and API\-first integration patterns using Kafka, MuleSoft, and REST/GraphQL APIs. Ensure seamless, secure, and scalable connectivity between core insurance systems—such as Policy, Claims, and Billing—and modern digital channels.



  




* **Data \& Analytics Architecture**
* Partner closely with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to design modern data architectures, including data lakes, data mesh implementations, and real\-time streaming platforms. These architectures should enable advanced analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning (ML) capabilities across the enterprise.



  




* **Security \& Resilience**
* Embed security by design throughout the architecture lifecycle. Implement zero\-trust networking principles, robust identity \& access management (IAM), strong encryption standards, and proven disaster\-recovery and business\-continuity architecture patterns.



  




* **Stakeholder Engagement**
* Communicate complex architectural concepts clearly and effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Produce well\-structured Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and present strategic architectural proposals and reviews to governance boards and executive leadership.



  





**Required Qualifications**

description:
**Description**
 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is leading the next phase of AI adoption and is seeking a hands\-on AI Specialist Solution Architect (SSA). AWS Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are technologists with deep domain\-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs.
   

  

 As part of the AWS sales organization, SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert\-level knowledge to solve. SSAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or design an entirely new cloud\-based system.
   

  

 Specialist SAs play a critical role in capturing customer feedback, advocating for roadmap enhancements and anticipating customer requirements as they work backwards from their needs. As domain experts, SSAs also participate in field engagement and enablement, producing content such as whitepapers, blogs, and workshops for customers, partners, and the AWS Technical Field.
   

  

 This role focuses on converting AI ambition into programs that can be delivered, operated, and scaled in production environments.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* The AI Specialist SA team builds technical relationships with customers of all sizes and operate as their trusted advisor, ensuring they get the most out of the cloud at every stage of their journey while adopting GenAI/ML and Agentic technologies across their organisation.
* You’ll manage the overall technical relationship between AWS and our customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency to accelerate their challenging GenAI/ML and Agentic projects.
* Internally, you will be the voice of the customer, sharing their needs with regard to their usage of our services impacting the roadmap of AWS GenAI/ML and Agentic features.
* In this role, your creativity will link technology to tangible solutions, with the opportunity to define cloud\-native GenAI/ML and Agentic architectural patterns for a variety of use cases.
* You will participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelize and educate about running GenAI/ML and Agentic workloads on AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).

* 5\+ years of management of technical, enterprise customer facing resources or equivalent experience
* Experience giving skills and communicating complex concepts clearly and effectively to diverse audiences across different functions
* Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product

* Hands\-on experience with AWS ecosystems (including Bedrock, AgentCore, and SageMaker) to set up secure, private\-network AI environments, and practical experience implementing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation using embeddings, vector stores, and semantic search optimization

* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience (non\-internship) in professional software development

* Experience developing solutions and executing plans on complex projects
